The venue for the sixth heat of the competition is The Box at FarGo Village, Coventry, an ultra-cool repurposed industrial space, smack in the city centre, which has, for one night only, been transformed into our very own comedy club.

Travelling onto the capital city of Madrid, Michael hears how the bombing of a small town in the Basque region in 1937 inspired one of the 20th century's most shocking works of art, before making his way to the town of Huesca. Adventure sequel, starring Ralph Macchio and Pat Morita

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc:
Tha Joy Dunlop gar toirt tro na ciad ceumannan a tha a dhìth airson ar misneachadh gus Gàidhlig a bhruidhinn. Thairis air an t-sreath, bidh i a' dèiligeadh ri facail is abairtean air measgachadh de chuspairean co-cheangailte ri gach taobh de ar beatha. Leis gun do dh'ionnsaich i fhèin, bheir Joy dhuinn briathrachas mu charaidean, an dachaigh, an teaghlach, obair agus an aimsir am measg gu leòr eile ann an dòigh a tha sìmplidh agus furasta a thuigsinn. Bidh stiùireadh ann cuideachd a thaobh a bhith a' cleachdadh abairtean, le eisimpleirean soilleir ann an dramathan goirid.
Coinnichidh sinn luchd-ionnsachaidh èasgaidh, feadhainn a tha ag ionnsachadh as ùr agus cuid a bha fileanta agus a sguir ga cleachdadh, agus iadsan a th' air a bhith ag ionnsachadh fad bhliadhnaichean. Agus bidh Calum MacIlleathain a' toirt sealladh eile dhuinn air Alba is e ann an diofar àitichean air feadh na dùthcha.
Lorgar tuilleadh stuthan taic air-loidhne: www.speakgaelic.scot agus ann an sreath phodcastan a tha ri fhaighinn air BBC Sounds.
We meet Gaelic learner Ben Geyer from Fife and Calum Maclean is in St Monans, finding out about the prosperity white gold brought to the area.
Supporting materials can be found online: www.speakgaelic.scot and in the SpeakGaelic podcasts on BBC Sounds.

programme.title: Modern Family

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: A day at the museum proves to be anything but fun when Cam, Mitch and Manny realise they can't hold their own against brainbox Alex. programme.title: Modern Family

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Adrian Perkins, the mayor of Shreveport, Louisiana, is in charge of 3,000 employees serving its 200,000 residents. Louisiana's third largest city has fallen on hard times with crime and unemployment on the rise. Mayor Perkins wants to change the fortunes of his home town and he thinks going undercover will help. As his alter ego Wayne Oliver, an unemployed steel worker looking for a new career, he works alongside a firefighter, a police officer and a parks maintenance worker to see what life is like working for the city, and gets the chance to meet his community without them knowing that they're talking to the mayor

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: The two founders of the College HUNKS Hauling Junk & Moving company go on separate assignments on the front line to determine if their business is secure enough to last

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Big kids Wizz and Luke kick off the week in Cambridgeshire with a children's party-themed night complete with food in colourful cardboard boxes. On night two demanding Diana and Mark host with a fine dining affair. Finally, Ed and Steve, who are usually smiley, start to feel the pressure - although their guests are in awe of their enormous trifle

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: Daydreamer Yanis wants his wedding to be a towering success as he plans to tie the knot at the Eiffel Tower. However, his hard-to-please bride Chanise has a tranquil wedding in the Scottish countryside in mind. As this controlling bride struggles to hand over the reins, in a series first, the wedding plans are leaked and the couple are left facing the consequences

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: Rugby-loving groom Wes is planning the biggest wedding ever, in front of 26,000 people at a premiership rugby match. However, his girly bride-to-be Charlotte is dreaming of a much more intimate day. Will Wes, who has never organised anything in his life, be able to pull off a wedding of this scale, or will his big day be a disaster?

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA

Kat has some lofty goals for Cinnabon to become a worldwide food brand, and wants to make sure that the new products she has put in place are working before she implements her plans

programme.title: Ex Machina
programme.desc: Sci-fi thriller starring Oscar Isaac and Domhnall Gleeson. A young software programmer is given the opportunity to spend time at the home of his company's reclusive chairman. But when he arrives he discovers that he will be required to be part of a strange experiment.

programme.title: I'm Your Man
programme.desc: Sci-fi romance starring Maren Eggert and Dan Stevens. In order to get funding for her research, academic Alma takes part in an unusual study: she is paired with a robot, named Tom, who is designed to embody her "ideal man". Initially unsettled by her new partner, Alma reacts with hostility, but over time her feelings unexpectedly evolve.

programme.title: The Devil at 4 O'Clock
programme.desc: A priest is sent to a South Seas island to replace a drunken missionary, who has been relieved of his duties. Sharing his flight are three convicts being sent to work at a children's leper hospital. The five men must work together to protect the young patients when a volcano erupts, leaving them stranded with no easy way out. Adventure, starring Spencer Tracy, Frank Sinatra and Kerwin Mathews

programme.title: Django Unchained Interview Special
programme.desc: Quentin Tarantino and the cast of his new Western discuss making the film

programme.title: The Guns of Fort Petticoat
programme.desc: A lieutenant deserts after his commanding officer launches an unprovoked attack on a Comanche village during the Civil War. Realising that there are no soldiers in his home town to protect it from reprisals, he returns to train the local women to defend themselves. Western, starring Audie Murphy, Kathryn Grant, Hope Emerson and Jeff Donnell

programme.title: The Shepherd of the Hills
programme.desc: Adventure starring John Wayne and Betty Field. Matt Matthews, an Ozark Mountains moonshiner, has vowed since boyhood to kill a man he has never seen - his own father, who seemingly deserted Matt's mother and left her to die. It's an all-consuming quest that's preventing him from marrying his sweetheart, Sammy Lane.

programme.title: Decision at Sundown
programme.desc: Western starring Randolph Scott. After years of searching, Bart Allison rides into Sundown to kill the man that he holds responsible for the death of his wife. However, the object of his vengeance is now under the protection of the town sheriff.

programme.title: The Adjustment Bureau
programme.desc: Romantic sci-fi drama starring Emily Blunt and Matt Damon. A seemingly random series of events brings ambitious politician David Norris together with ballet dancer Elise Sellas, with whom he falls in love. But was their meeting down to chance, and are there now supernatural forces conspiring to keep them apart?

programme.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring James Franco and Freida Pinto. When scientist Will Rodman's programme of drug experiments to find a cure for Alzheimer's disease is shut down he secretly takes an offspring from one of the chimpanzees he was using into his home and names him Caesar. Caesar has inherited the effects of the trial drug and begins to show remarkable intelligence, a development that will put him on a violent collision course with the humans who have abused him.

programme.title: Nope
programme.desc: Sci-fi horror starring Daniel Kaluuya and Keke Palmer. Siblings OJ and Em Haywood have taken over their late father's California ranch, where they train horses for use in Hollywood productions. After a series of bizarre occurrences around their property, OJ and Em take measures to record and capture the source of the chaos: a monstrous UFO.

programme.title: The Great British Christmas Menu

programme.desc: Guy Fieri tries out favourites from around the corner and around the globe. He tries classic lomo saltado, a special beef sandwich, and Wiener Schnitzel.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives

programme.title: Ghosts
programme.desc: The ghosts are officially bored, and Pat comes up with new entertainment for the gang. Mike and Alison host their international buyer at Button House in order to confirm the land sale, but Mike's antics threaten the whole deal - can he pull it back in time? Humphrey is offered a fresh perspective on his strained marriage and finally learns some French, with a little help from a most unexpected source

programme.title: Ghosts
programme.desc: Robin has an epiphany that has a far-reaching impact on the rest of the ghosts, who each struggle to believe his prediction. Alison suggests a spontaneous night out with Mike and they try to get the old gang together, but only Obi and his new girlfriend Brenda are free at such short notice. Despite Alison's efforts to plan the best night ever, the evening doesn't quite meet her expectations, and the couple are left pondering how much their lives are changing

programme.title: Ghosts
programme.desc: Mike and Alison receive a life-changing offer beyond their wildest dreams. Still reeling from the news and anxious to discuss it, they are interrupted by a heartbroken Obi, who has been suddenly dumped by a strangely callous Brenda. Alison and Mike agree to reconvene with lists of pros and cons, while Alison must fend off the ghosts, who are desperate to sway her decision

programme.title: Only Fools and Horses
programme.desc: The Trotters go on a lads' day out to Margate with their mates, but things do not go as expected when their bus blows up, leaving them stranded overnight in the seaside town. Finding a room in the hotel from hell, the brothers are only too happy to go out and sample the local nightlife - and that's when Del-Boy gets a blast from the past. Feature-length Christmas special from 1989, starring David Jason and Nicholas Lyndhurst

programme.title: Toast of London
programme.desc: London is having the hottest weather since weather began, Ed's Australian nephew has come to stay, and the 'Blue Spruce' furniture fad is spreading like wildfire. Meanwhile, Steven begs Jane to get him in at the Globe Theatre, and he is less than impressed with the director, Daz Klondyke. However, when he is cast in an all-dog version of Twelfth Night, he gets his fingers burnt during his quest to become a real actor. Conclusion of the third series of the comedy, starring Matt Berry, Doon Mackichan and Robert Bathurst

programme.desc: Michael Portillo traces the early 20th-century roots of the Spanish Civil War, which divided his family and sent his father into exile. The former politician discovers a nation fractured at the time by social tensions and regional loyalties, which today offer a rich diversity of cultures to delight the tourist. After arriving in Majorca from Barcelona, Michael spoils himself enjoying spectacular scenic views aboard a 1912 vintage railway and a 1913 tram. programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Armed with a 1936 edition of Bradshaw's Continental Railway Guide, Michael Portillo ventures onto the European rail network, beginning an emotional rail journey which takes him deep into his family's past. In the golden city of Salamanca in northwestern Spain, Michael visits the University to hear of opposition to the fascist takeover of Spain by General Francisco Franco, and gains access to the General's archive of enemies of the state. Travelling onto the capital city of Madrid, Michael hears how the bombing of a small town in the Basque region in 1937 inspired one of the 20th century's most shocking works of art, before making his way to the town of Huesca. Michael's final stop is on the border with France at Canfranc station, where he learns of the role the old terminus played in the evacuation of Jews during the Second World War

programme.desc:
Twenty-one-year-old Newcastle lass Kelsie loves nothing more than showing off her acrobatic party tricks, vlogging dates live to her friends and having a cheeky cocktail or three on a first date. Her wild antics are keeping the lads away, and Kelsie's chances of getting a second date are nil!
Best mate Tegan thinks Kelsie is hopeless when it comes to dating. Fed up with giving advice that falls on deaf ears, Tegan has enlisted the help of sex and relationship expert Oloni for a much-needed intervention. Oloni gives Kelsie a cold dose of reality as she asks friends, family and exes to dish the dirt via video feedback to show Kelsie where it's all going wrong.
With a string of dating fails under Kelsie's belt, Oloni sends her on three challenge dates and watches on with Tegan as Kelsie tries to practice some first date dos and don'ts, but can Kelsie resist doing the crab when one of her dates turns out to be an acrobat?

In order to try to overcome her fears, she wants to face death head on, so joins the team of funeral directors at Nottinghamshire-based firm, AW Lymn, one of the largest independent funeral enterprises in the country. Stacey fully immerses herself in every aspect of the company's day-to-day work to discover more about the business of death - from arranging funerals to making coffins, learning more about embalming to carving elaborate headstones - and tries to get the answers she has been searching for

programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Ryan Reynolds, Amy Smart and Anna Faris. Chris was once an overweight loser, but is now slim, successful and a compulsive womaniser. Returning to his home town, he becomes determined to win the heart of the girl who was his best friend in high school.

programme.title: Black Christmas
programme.desc: While heading home, Hawthorne College student Lindsey is impaled with an icicle by a masked individual. It's the beginning of a bloodthirsty rampage, prompting Riley Stone and her friends to fight back. Co-writer/director Sophia Takal's horror remake, starring Imogen Poots, Lily Donoghue, Aleyse Shannon and Brittany O'Grady

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Nov 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: How the Grinch Stole Christmas
programme.desc: Comedy fantasy starring Jim Carrey. It's Christmas in Whoville and preparations are well under way. Meanwhile, up in his mountain lair, cold-hearted hermit the Grinch sits alone resenting the Whovians' happiness. But then he's befriended by a little girl.

programme.title: Four Christmases
programme.desc: Seasonal comedy starring Reese Witherspoon and Vince Vaughn. The potent mix of Christmas and relations presents a special challenge for Kate and Brad, who are forced to visit all of their four divorced parents on Christmas Day. Along the way they discover things about themselves and each other.

programme.title: The Polar Express
programme.desc: Seasonal animated fantasy featuring Tom Hanks. On Christmas Eve, a young boy lies in bed pondering if Santa Claus really exists. Startled by a thunderous sound, he goes outside to discover a magical train destined for the North Pole. As he cautiously climbs on board, he begins an amazing journey that changes his view of the festive season for ever.

programme.title: National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation
programme.desc: Comedy starring Chevy Chase and Beverly D'Angelo. The accident-prone Griswold family decides to spend a traditional Christmas at home. But the peace is shattered when the decorations start to go up and the relatives arrive.

programme.title: Scrooged
programme.desc: Seasonal comedy, starring Bill Murray, Karen Allen and featuring Robert Mitchum. Frank Cross, the youngest network president in television history, is a man who hates Christmas and plans to exploit the holidays to attract as many viewers as possible, no matter what it takes. However, Frank is about to be visited by three unconventional ghosts who will go to any lengths to make him change his mean-spirited ways.

programme.title: Love Actually
programme.desc: Ensemble romantic comedy featuring Hugh Grant, Emma Thompson, Alan Rickman, Keira Knightley and Bill Nighy. In London, during the weeks leading up to Christmas, people from various walks of life - among them adult film performers, a washed-up rock star and the British Prime Minister - suffer the emotional highs and lows of being in love.

programme.title: The Holiday
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Cameron Diaz, Kate Winslet, Jude Law and Jack Black. After breaking up with her boyfriend, Los Angeles workaholic Amanda is in need of a holiday. An online search persuades her to exchange her California home over Christmas for the remote Surrey cottage of journalist Iris, who has just found out her ex is getting married. But the transatlantic swap soon leads to more romantic entanglements for the two women.

programme.title: Last Christmas
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Emilia Clarke, Henry Golding and Emma Thompson. London, 2017: life could be better for twenty-something chaos magnet Kate, who has her heart set on being a singer but works all year round as an elf in a Covent Garden store. Then she meets too-good-to-be true Tom. Could romance be in the air?

programme.title: Just Friends
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Ryan Reynolds, Amy Smart and Anna Faris. Chris was once an overweight loser, but is now slim, successful and a compulsive womaniser. Returning to his home town, he becomes determined to win the heart of the girl who was his best friend in high school.

programme.title: Four Christmases
programme.desc: Seasonal comedy starring Reese Witherspoon and Vince Vaughn. The potent mix of Christmas and relations presents a special challenge for Kate and Brad, who are forced to visit all of their four divorced parents on Christmas Day. Along the way they discover things about themselves and each other.

programme.title: The Bourne Legacy
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Jeremy Renner, Rachel Weisz and Edward Norton. As the CIA's covert operations are compromised and details are leaked to the media, intelligence chiefs decide to cut their losses and kill every agent testing their top secret genetic experiment. Agent Aaron Cross manages to escape the onslaught, but must contact the scientist behind Operation Outcome to maintain his enhanced functions and foil his handlers.

programme.title: Jason Bourne
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Matt Damon, Tommy Lee Jones and Alicia Vikander. Now living in self-imposed exile, former agent Jason Bourne is contacted by an old colleague and is soon drawn into an operation to expose CIA dirty tricks. And, as Bourne well knows, nothing is as it seems and no one can be trusted.

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: Spy action thriller based on the novel by Robert Ludlum, starring Matt Damon and Franka Potente. Jason Bourne is rescued from the Mediterranean with bullet wounds in his back and suffering from amnesia. When he regains consciousness, he discovers that the only clue to his identity is a laser device under his skin, which reveals the name of a Zurich bank and the numbers of a Swiss bank account.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Nov 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: Spy action thriller, the first sequel to The Bourne Identity, starring Matt Damon. Ex-CIA agent Jason Bourne, still suffering memory loss following an accident, finds his life in danger when he is implicated in the killing of an agent in Berlin.

programme.title: The Bourne Ultimatum
programme.desc: Spy action thriller, starring Matt Damon, Julia Stiles and Joan Allen. When an article about a covert CIA operation appears in The Guardian, trained assassin Jason Bourne sets off for London to meet the journalist behind the exposé who may be able to shed light on Bourne's past. But his former employers are also on the trail with instructions to make sure that the meeting never happens.

And, as Bourne well knows, nothing is as it seems and no one can be trusted.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Mark Wahlberg. Four years after the Battle of Chicago, the Autobots are now in hiding from the US government after being deemed a threat to humanity. So when struggling engineer Cade Yeager comes across an old semi truck while looking for parts, he soon finds himself on the radar of government forces and an alien bounty hunter.

programme.title: Transformers: The Last Knight
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Mark Wahlberg and Anthony Hopkins. When Optimus Prime returns to what is left of Cybertron, he is brainwashed by seductive leader Quintessa to return to Earth to obtain a mystical staff belonging to Merlin which will bring his home planet back to life.

programme.title: 300: Rise of an Empire
programme.desc: Ruler of the Persian empire and self-proclaimed god Xerxes continues his campaign to crush the emerging Greek nation, forcing a general from the democratic city state of Athens to lead his navy into battle against Xerxes' vast armada. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Sullivan Stapleton, Eva Green and Lena Headey

Historical action adventure starring Gerard Butler, Lena Headey and David Wenham. When the fiercely ambitious King Xerxes of Persia plans to invade Greece, King Leonidas mobilises his personal bodyguard of 300 Spartan warriors to defend the pass at Thermopylae.

programme.title: Hummingbird
programme.desc: Thriller starring Jason Statham. A troubled former soldier on the run from a court martial assumes another man's identity and goes into hiding on the streets of London. But the desire to avenge injustice is something he can never leave behind.

programme.title: The Fast and the Furious
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Paul Walker and Vin Diesel. When illegal street racer Dominic Toretto is suspected of being the mastermind behind a series of truck hijacks, undercover police officer Brian O'Conner is sent to infiltrate his gang. But O'Conner's judgement becomes clouded when he falls in love with Toretto's sister, Mia.

programme.title: 2 Fast 2 Furious
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Paul Walker. Disgraced cop Brian O'Conner is given the chance to redeem himself by going under cover to entrap a powerful Miami drugs baron.

programme.title: The Fast and the Furious: Tokyo Drift
programme.desc: Action thriller sequel starring Lucas Black. To avoid jail for illegal street racing, a bad-boy teenager is sent to Japan to stay with his estranged father. However, his discovery of drifting, a new style of racing reliant on the use of oversteering, soon gets him into more trouble.

programme.title: Fast & Furious
programme.desc: Action thriller in which Vin Diesel and Paul Walker, the stars of the first film in the street-racing franchise, team up again. Criminal Dominic Toretto returns to LA to avenge the murder of one of his friends by a drug kingpin, bringing him face to face with an old rival - FBI agent Brian O'Conner.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 5
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Dwayne Johnson, Vin Diesel and Paul Walker. Fugitive Dominic Toretto assembles his old team to steal $100 million from Brazil's most corrupt businessman so that they can disappear for ever. But with tenacious FBI agent Luke Hobbs on their trail, their plan just got a lot more complicated.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 6
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Vin Diesel, Paul Walker and Dwayne Johnson. Following a heist in Rio, Dominic Toretto's gang has dispersed to different places around the world. But the offer of reassembling for one last job proves attractive when it carries with it the chance of a pardon for past misdemeanours.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 7
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Vin Diesel, Paul Walker, Dwayne Johnson and Jason Statham. When it becomes apparent that someone out for revenge is picking off members of his crew one by one, Dominic Toretto decides the gang should get back together. But no sooner have they reassembled than they're co-opted by a shadowy agency figure, who needs the team's special skills to help steal a surveillance device known as God's Eye.

programme.title: Stuart Little
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy adventure based on EB White's children's story, starring Hugh Laurie and Geena Davis, and featuring the voice of Michael J Fox. The Littles want to adopt a younger brother for their son, George. At the orphanage they are charmed by a young mouse called Stuart, and decide to take him home. While George is stunned by his new companion, the family cat, Snowbell, is delighted.

programme.title: Stuart Little 2
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure based on the characters created by EB White, starring Geena Davis and Hugh Laurie, and featuring the voice of Michael J Fox as the lovable talking mouse. Stuart loses his heart to a little bird called Margalo when he nurses her back to health following an encounter with a vicious falcon. But his new-found love hides a dark secret.

programme.title: Journey 2: The Mysterious Island
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Dwayne Johnson, Michael Caine and Josh Hutcherson. A teenage adventurer locates an island inhabited by monster lizards, giant bees and a gold volcano.

programme.title: Wonder Park
programme.desc: Animated fantasy adventure featuring the voices of Brianna Denski, Jennifer Garner and Mila Kunis. June and her mother while away the hours playing with stuffed animals and imagining a fabulous theme park called "Wonderland". But when Mom is taken to hospital, June runs off into the woods and discovers the Wonderland characters living out a gloomy existence there. Can June make everything right again?

programme.title: A Dog's Purpose
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Britt Robertson and Dennis Quaid, and featuring the voice of Josh Gad. Young Ethan is devastated when his dog and best friend Bailey dies. But Bailey knows that it's not only cats that have nine lives.

programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure. When the secret formula for the addictive Krabby Patty is stolen by pirate Burger Beard, Mr Krabs seconds SpongeBob to head into the live-action world and get it back. But will the dastardly pirate give it up without a fight?

programme.title: Shaun the Sheep Movie
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure from Aardman. Shaun's plan to have a lazy day on Mossy Bottom Farm backfires when a cunning ruse sees the Farmer end up lost in the Big City. Shaun and the flock set off to find him, but to succeed they will have to avoid capture by an eager animal control officer, with nothing but elaborate disguises and quick wits.

programme.title: A Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure from Aardman, featuring the voices of Justin Fletcher and John Sparkes. Life at Mossy Bottom Farm takes a surprising turn when an alien crash-lands nearby. The extraterrestrial visitor is friendly enough, but when it transpires that a government agent is on its trail, Shaun the Sheep and friends come up with a plan to help the newcomer get back home.

programme.title: Super Charlie
programme.desc: Willie's dream of fighting crime with his cop dad is shattered when his baby brother Charlie arrives. And the new family member turns out to have superpowers. Family animation, with the voices of Karen Ardiff and Alex Kelly

programme.title: Chicken Run
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure, with the voices of Julia Sawalha, Jane Horrocks, Miranda Richardson and Mel Gibson. A clutch of hens, led by head chick Ginger, suffers life on a grim 1950s egg farm. When the avaricious owners decide to move into the meat-pie business, the chickens fear the worst. With the help of American rooster Rocky, the birds start to plan a prisoner-of-war-style escape.

programme.title: Trolls
programme.desc: Animated musical adventure featuring the voices of Justin Timberlake and Anna Kendrick. The happy land of trolls comes under threat from the Bergens, their miserable, giant neighbours who have developed a taste for trolls. When their kinfolk are kidnapped, bickering trolls Branch and Princess Poppy set out to free them before they're served up for dinner.

programme.title: Smurfs: The Lost Village
programme.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voices of Demi Lovato and Rainn Wilson. Smurfette and friends embark on their biggest ever adventure - travelling beyond the Forbidden Forest in search of other Smurfs.

programme.title: Tafiti - Across the Desert
programme.desc: A young meerkat's grandpa is bitten by a snake, so he sets off to find a magical flower for the cure. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Cosima Henman, Steve Hudson and Kathleen Renish

programme.title: Dog Man
programme.desc: A half-human canine is sworn to protect and serve as he faces feline supervillain Petey the Cat. Animated comedy, with the voices of Pete Davidson, Poppy Liu, Lil Rel Howery and Isla Fisher

programme.title: E.T.: The Extra-Terrestrial
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg's classic sci-fi adventure, starring Henry Thomas and Dee Wallace, and featuring Drew Barrymore. Ten-year-old Elliott has a new friend, but he's from another planet and nobody must know he's here.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Comedy horror based on the classic TV series, starring Anjelica Huston, Raul Julia and Christopher Lloyd. The ghoulish but happy Addams family are tricked out of their fortune when an impostor claims he's their long-lost Uncle Fester.

programme.title: Casper
programme.desc: Supernatural comedy fantasy starring Christina Ricci, Bill Pullman, Cathy Moriarty and Eric Idle. A wicked heiress hires Dr Harvey, a specialist on ghosts, to rid the haunted house she has inherited of its unwanted inhabitants. But Casper, the nice nephew of nasty ghosts Stretch, Stinkie and Fatso, strikes up a friendship with the doctor's daughter.

programme.title: The Borrowers
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring John Goodman and Jim Broadbent. Pod, Homily and their children Peagreen and Arietty are the Borrowers, a family of tiny people living secretly in the house of young Pete. When Pete's Great Aunt Mary dies, no one can find the will and it looks as if the house may fall into the hands of nasty local lawyer, Ocious P Potter, and put the little family in danger.

programme.title: Babe
programme.desc: Fantasy comedy starring James Cromwell. Babe, an orphaned pig, is raised on a farm by the sheepdog Fly. Although he is destined for the dinner table, Babe astonishes Farmer Hoggett and his fellow farmyard animals when he shows talent as a "sheep-pig".

programme.title: Small Soldiers
programme.desc: Fantasy action adventure starring Kirsten Dunst, Gregory Smith and featuring the voice of Tommy Lee Jones. When an overeager toy designer installs state-of-the-art military microchips into a line of action figures, the result is a battle royal between the Commando Elite and the peaceful Gorgonites. The problem is that the battleground is the suburban household of young Alan Abernathy.

programme.title: Jackie Chan's First Strike
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Jackie Chan. On an assignment to track down an arms dealer in Australia, a Hong Kong policeman makes contact with the local Triad and discovers that the Russian intelligence officer who recruited him has criminal motives.

programme.title: The Witches of Eastwick
programme.desc: Three single women dabble in magic to conjure up the perfect lover, and unintentionally summon Satan himself, who seduces them one by one. They come to realise the danger the lecherous devil presents and decide to end their relationships, but the infernal rogue does not take kindly to rejection. Fantasy comedy based on John Updike's novel, with Jack Nicholson, Cher, Michelle Pfeiffer and Susan Sarandon

programme.title: Hook
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Dustin Hoffman, Robin Williams, Julia Roberts and Bob Hoskins. Workaholic lawyer Peter Banning and his family spend Christmas in London with an old relative, Granny Wendy. The adults arrive home one evening to find that the children have vanished and a note has been left by Captain James Hook. With the help of a fairy named Tinkerbell, Peter sets off for Neverland to reclaim his offspring.

programme.title: The Karate Kid
programme.desc: Martial arts adventure starring Ralph Macchio. When Daniel LaRusso moves from New Jersey to California, he becomes a target for a bullying gang of teenagers. Knowing he must learn how to defend himself, he strikes up a friendship with a wise old Japanese man, who teaches him the secrets of karate. However, his bitterest enemy is also taking martial arts lessons and the scene is set for an explosive confrontation.

programme.title: The Karate Kid Part II
programme.desc: Martial arts adventure sequel starring Ralph Macchio. Following his success in an American karate championship, Daniel LaRusso travels with his teacher to his home island of Okinawa. There he finds himself facing his severest challenge.

programme.title: The Karate Kid Part III
programme.desc: The teenage martial arts expert becomes obsessed with defending his championship title, but wise mentor Mr Miyagi is not prepared to help him fight for such a shallow goal. Seeking someone else to help guide his career, he falls under the influence of a crooked trainer - who is secretly plotting his downfall with the help of an old adversary. Adventure sequel, starring Ralph Macchio and Pat Morita

programme.title: Liar Liar
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jim Carrey. Lawyer Fletcher Reede is a compulsive liar. When his deceits lead to him missing his son's birthday party, the boy makes a wish that his dad would find it impossible not to tell the truth. The wish comes magically true - with hilarious consequences.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Arnold Schwarzenegger as tough Los Angeles cop John Kimble, who's facing the greatest challenge of his career - going under cover as a kindergarten teacher to track down the family of a vicious mobster.

programme.title: The Wedding Singer
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Adam Sandler and Drew Barrymore. Wedding singer Robbie Hart is usually the master of the big occasion, but when his own bride leaves him at the altar, his life - and performances - go to pieces. Then he meets Julia, who seems to be his perfect partner, but she's already engaged and wants Robbie to organise her wedding.

programme.title: Sixteen Candles
programme.desc: A teenager's parents forget her birthday, so she tries to get over her disappointment by searching for the man of her dreams, unaware she's looking in the wrong place. Comedy drama, starring Molly Ringwald, Justin Henry and Anthony Michael Hall

programme.title: Police Academy 2: Their First Assignment
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Steve Guttenberg. Given 30 days to halt the crime wave in his precinct, Captain Pete Lassard recruits six rookie cops from his brother's police academy. But the rookies' ineptitude and an ambitious lieutenant soon put Lassard's job in jeopardy.

programme.title: Talladega Nights: The Ballad of Ricky Bobby
programme.desc: Comedy starring Will Ferrell, John C Reilly and Sacha Baron Cohen. Nascar racing champion Ricky Bobby has all the trappings of a successful career: a glamorous wife, a luxury home and a fanatical fan base. But when French driver Jean Girard threatens Ricky's dominance, he seems ill-equipped to meet the challenge.

programme.title: Sixteen Candles
programme.desc: A teenager's parents forget her birthday, so she tries to get over her disappointment by searching for the man of her dreams, unaware she's looking in the wrong place. Comedy drama, starring Molly Ringwald, Justin Henry and Anthony Michael Hall

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Satirical comedy of suburban paranoia starring Tom Hanks. Ray Peterson's peace of mind is being eroded by the seemingly sinister goings-on next door. Are the mysterious Klopeks really neighbours from hell, doing dastardly deeds at the dead of night? Or are they just quiet people minding their own business? The "good people" of Mayfield Place are determined to discover the hideous truth.

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
programme.desc: Period comedy starring Will Ferrell. Ron Burgundy is the top newsreader at a San Diego TV station in the 1970s. But his position comes under threat with the arrival of ambitious reporter Veronica Corningstone. Male chauvinist Burgundy is torn between defending his job and his attraction to the glamorous newcomer.

programme.title: Anchorman 2: The Legend Continues
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Will Ferrell and Steve Carell. After a disastrous move to New York in which he became estranged from his co-anchor wife and was fired from his job, anchorman Ron Burgundy is hired by a ruthless network executive to work the graveyard shift on the world's first 24-hour rolling news channel.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Best friends Doug and Griff became obsessed with the film Anaconda when they were children and have always dreamed of remaking their favourite picture. When both men find themselves in the grip of a mid-life crisis, they fast track their film-making ambitions and head into the Amazon jungle with pals Claire and Kenny to shoot their slithering masterpiece. Comedy adventure, starring Jack Black, Paul Rudd and Thandiwe Newton

programme.title: White Chicks
programme.desc: Comedy starring Marlon Wayans and Shawn Wayans. Two black brothers are threatened with expulsion from the FBI following a failed drugs bust. In an attempt to save their jobs, they disguise themselves as rich, white socialite sisters to uncover and foil a kidnapping plot.

programme.title: You've Got Mail
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Meg Ryan and Tom Hanks as the owners of rival New York bookshops. When Joe Fox threatens to put Kathleen Kelly out of business, he shares his misgivings about the impending closure of her store and other personal secrets with an anonymous chat-room partner - and makes a startling discovery that only adds to his dilemma.

programme.title: The Naked Gun
programme.desc: Following in the footsteps of his legendary father, Frank Drebin Jr must save his police department by solving a case. Comedy reboot, starring Liam Neeson, Pamela Anderson and Danny Huston

programme.title: 50 First Dates
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Adam Sandler and Drew Barrymore. Womanising vet Henry Roth ditches his playboy lifestyle after falling for the charming Lucy. But a car crash has left her with severe short term memory loss, meaning that Henry has to romance her all over again every day in the hope that eventually she'll remember him.

programme.title: 21 Jump Street
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Channing Tatum and Jonah Hill. Underachieving rookie cops Jenko and Schmidt are given the chance to make their names when they are sent back to their old high school to infiltrate a drugs ring. But unfortunately the new boys don't blend in as well as was hoped.

programme.title: 22 Jump Street
programme.desc: Action comedy sequel starring Channing Tatum and Jonah Hill. Cops Jenko and Schmidt are back masquerading as students, this time to unmask a drug dealer with links to organised crime. But they soon discover that you can get too deep under cover.

programme.title: Team America: World Police
programme.desc: Satirical comedy co-written, directed by and featuring the voices of South Park creators Trey Parker and Matt Stone, and performed by Thunderbirds-style puppets. A counter-terrorism squad causes havoc as it does battle with the Film Actors Guild and North Korean dictator Kim Jong Il, who is bent on destroying the civilised world.

programme.title: Strung
programme.desc: A talented violinist whose new job tutoring for an elite family turns into a battle for safety and sanity when she realises her past is linked to the family's patriarch. Thriller, starring Chloe Bailey, Lynn Whitfield and Lucien Laviscount

programme.title: The Towering Inferno
programme.desc: Disaster movie starring Steve McQueen and Paul Newman. On the grand opening night of the world's tallest skyscraper, an electrical fault starts a fire in a storeroom. Panic takes a hold as the blaze begins to engulf the new tower and the fire department is called in for its toughest job yet.

programme.title: Borderline
programme.desc: A bodyguard protects a pop superstar and her athlete boyfriend from a determined stalker in 1990s Los Angeles. Director Jimmy Warden's dark comedy horror, starring Samara Weaving and Ray Nicholson

programme.title: Carolina Caroline
programme.desc: A young woman falls for a charismatic con man on the run, joining him on a reckless journey across the American Southeast. As their crimes grow bolder and their passion deepens, she searches for the mother who abandoned her. Crime thriller, starring Samara Weaving and Kyle Gallner

programme.title: Murder by Numbers
programme.desc: Detective thriller starring Sandra Bullock and Ben Chaplin. An overprivileged teenager and his bookish companion think they have committed the perfect murder, but emotionally damaged cop Cassie Mayweather has a hunch that they are the culprits. Her problem is convincing sceptical colleagues that she's right.

programme.title: Civil War
programme.desc: Action drama starring Kirsten Dunst, Wagner Moura and Cailee Spaeny. The USA is ravaged by civil war. Documenting the atrocities, a group of journalists - including veteran photographer Lee, reporter Joel and rookie Jessie - travel from New York to Washington DC to interview the President before armed secessionist militias reach the capital.

programme.title: The Accountant
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Ben Affleck and Anna Kendrick. Unassuming accountant Christian Wolff struggles to balance his work for both criminal organisations and legitimate businesses, which draws him into a complex web of deception.

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: Comedy crime drama starring Brad Pitt, Jason Statham and Benicio Del Toro. In Antwerp, jewel thief Franky Four Fingers steals a huge diamond, but before he can deliver it to his New York boss he is ambushed in London by a Russian mobster's henchmen. Elsewhere in the capital, crimelord Brick Top demands that Irish boxer Mickey One Punch take a dive in an unlicensed fight. When Brick Top joins the hunt for the missing gem, mayhem ensues.

programme.title: RocknRolla
programme.desc: A Russian mob boss sets up a profitable real-estate scam in London and soon every criminal in the city is after their share. The gangster's accountant hires a trio of crooks to take his boss's millions, while a rock star with a penchant for faking his own death causes further mayhem by stealing a valuable painting. Guy Ritchie's crime comedy, starring Gerard Butler, Tom Wilkinson and Thandie Newton

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: Oscar-winning crime thriller from the Coen brothers, starring Tommy Lee Jones, Javier Bardem and Josh Brolin. After going on the run with $2 million from a botched desert drugs deal, hapless cowboy Llewelyn Moss is pursued across Texas by sociopathic hitman Anton Chigurh and ageing sheriff Ed Tom Bell.

programme.title: Drop
programme.desc: A widowed mother's first date in years takes a chilling turn when she's bombarded with anonymous threatening phone messages during their dinner, leaving her questioning if her charming suitor is behind the harassment. Director Christopher Landon's thriller, starring Meghann Fahy and Brandon Sklenar

programme.title: The Accountant
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Ben Affleck and Anna Kendrick. Unassuming accountant Christian Wolff struggles to balance his work for both criminal organisations and legitimate businesses, which draws him into a complex web of deception.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Supernatural horror based on Stephen King's novel, starring Jason Clarke, Amy Seimetz and John Lithgow. Shortly after the Creed family move to a new town, their cat is killed in a traffic accident. Neighbour Jud suggests they lay the animal to rest in an ancient woodland burial ground. When the family is rocked by tragedy, though, events take a macabre turn.

programme.title: Event Horizon
programme.desc: A deep-space salvage crew investigate mysterious events aboard a hi-tech spaceship, which suddenly reappeared in orbit around Neptune after going missing for seven years - but it is not long before they are exposed to terror beyond their wildest nightmares. Sci-fi horror, starring Laurence Fishburne, Sam Neill, Kathleen Quinlan, Joely Richardson and Sean Pertwee

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 3: The Hangman's Daughter
programme.desc: Prequel to the acclaimed horror tale, in which a band of Western outlaws and unfortunate travellers stumble across a remote bar inhabited by suspicious looking characters _ who turn out to be vampires. Marco Leonardi, Michael Parks and Temuera Morrison star

programme.title: Mad Max
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Mel Gibson. In Australia in the near future, urban society is in terminal decay. Spurred on by tragedy, policeman Max Rockatansky decides to enforce a new kind of law - that of cold-blooded revenge.

programme.title: Presence
programme.desc: Supernatural drama starring Lucy Liu, Callina Liang and Chris Sullivan. A mute ghost watches on as a family moves into a spacious suburban home and hidden tensions rise to the surface. Mother Rebekah seems to be involved in a crime, while teenage daughter Chloe, who is grieving after a friend's fatal overdose, begins to sense the unseen presence when it intervenes in the family's life.

programme.title: Assassin's Creed
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Michael Fassbender and Marion Cotillard. An Assassin descendant must explore his genetic memories to end the ancient war between his clan and the Templars. Travelling back in time to 15th-century Spain, he gathers the skills and powers he needs to defeat his enemies in the present day.

programme.title: Mad Max
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Mel Gibson. In Australia in the near future, urban society is in terminal decay. Spurred on by tragedy, policeman Max Rockatansky decides to enforce a new kind of law - that of cold-blooded revenge.

programme.title: Green Lantern
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure based on the comic book series, starring Ryan Reynolds. Cocky test pilot Hal Jordan is inducted into an intergalactic peacekeeping force when he inherits a ring from an alien race that endows him with superpowers.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Horror adventure starring Jennifer Lopez, Ice Cube and Jon Voight. In the Amazon jungle, a documentary crew rescues a loner who turns out to be a man obsessed. Life becomes dangerous for them all as he attempts to capture a lethal 40ft anaconda...

programme.title: The Shining
programme.desc: Stanley Kubrick's chilling horror, starring Jack Nicholson and Shelley Duvall. Aspiring writer and recovering alcoholic Jack Torrance takes on the job of winter caretaker at the remote Overlook Hotel, despite a warning about the psychological strain the long months of isolation can cause. Jack's wife Wendy only hopes that Jack will finally find the time to write, but his psychically gifted son Danny has visions of a terrifying ordeal for the family.

programme.title: Star Trek Into Darkness
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pine, Zachary Quinto and Benedict Cumberbatch. Captain Kirk's disdain for protocol sees him stripped of the command of the Enterprise, but he is given a chance to prove himself after volunteering to find and stop a mysterious operative who's out to destroy Starfleet.

programme.title: Oblivion
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Tom Cruise. In the year 2077, Jack Harper works as a drone repairman on an Earth left abandoned and devastated after a war with aliens. With only a few weeks before his mission is due to end, Jack's concept of reality comes crashing down after he rescues a stranger from a downed spacecraft.

programme.title: Gattaca
programme.desc: Science-fiction thriller starring Ethan Hawke, Uma Thurman and Jude Law. Vincent is an outsider, meaning that his birth was natural, making him "In-valid". The world in which he lives is ruled by "designer people" - that is, people forged in test tubes. He is only able to pursue his goal of a mission to space by buying prime genetic material from a "Valid" and forge a new identity. Then he meets Irene, another "Valid", but a week before his flight a Gattaca mission director is brutally murdered.

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: Remake of the John Wayne western from the Coen brothers, starring Jeff Bridges and Matt Damon. When farmer Frank Ross is murdered by a hired hand, his teenage daughter Mattie decides to take the matter in hand and find a man with "true grit" to bring the killer to justice. Mattie's search leads her to "Rooster" Cogburn, a hard-drinking, one-eyed US marshal with a fearsome reputation.

programme.title: Legends of the Fall
programme.desc: Epic drama starring Brad Pitt, Anthony Hopkins and Aidan Quinn. Three brothers, Alfred, Samuel and Tristan, are raised by their ex-cavalry father on a remote ranch near the Montana Rockies. Their lifestyle is irreversibly changed when Samuel brings home his beautiful fiancée, Susannah, and the brothers decide to join the army to fight in the First World War.

programme.title: A Good Person
programme.desc: Allison is a young woman whose world falls apart when she survives an unimaginable tragedy. While in recovery for an opioid addiction and unresolved grief, she forms an unlikely friendship with her would-be father-in-law, Daniel, that gives her a fighting chance to put her life back together. Writer/director Zach Braff's drama, starring Florence Pugh and Morgan Freeman

programme.title: Air
programme.desc: In 1984, Nike's basketball talent scout Sonny Vaccaro believes the company should invest its entire annual 250,000 US dollar budget in one prospect: 21-year-old NBA rookie Michael Jordan. Vaccaro travels to North Carolina to speak directly to Michael's parents Deloris and James. Drama starring Matt Damon, Viola Davis and Ben Affleck

programme.title: My Girl
programme.desc: Romantic drama starring Dan Aykroyd, Jamie Lee Curtis and Macaulay Culkin. Tomboy Vada Sultenfuss is not only a hypochondriac, but also preoccupied with death - a condition not helped by the fact that she lives above a funeral parlour where her father Harry works as a mortician. When Harry employs Shelly to help in the mortuary, Vada is concerned that her father and Shelly will become involved. So, along with her best friend Thomas J, she sets out to spy on the couple.

programme.title: Stand By Me
programme.desc: Coming-of-age drama, based on a story by Stephen King, starring Wil Wheaton and River Phoenix. A writer looks back on his childhood in late-1950s Oregon, in particular the time when he and his friends set out to find the corpse of a boy believed to have been hit by a train.

programme.title: Wuthering Heights
programme.desc: Catherine Earnshaw is raised by her alcoholic father at a Yorkshire farmhouse, with Nelly Dean as a constant companion. Mr Earnshaw 'acquires' an orphaned boy named Heathcliff during one of his gallivants and gifts the waif to Cathy as her pet. The children become inseparable, and as adults they embark on a destructive relationship. Writer-director Emerald Fennell's drama based on Emily Bronte's romance, starring Margot Robbie, Jacob Elordi and Martin Clunes

programme.title: Bohemian Rhapsody
programme.desc: Biographical music drama starring Rami Malek. London, 1970: living with his parents, Farrokh Bulsara dreams of becoming a rock star. So when local group Smile loses its lead singer, he convinces guitarist Brian May and drummer Roger Taylor to give him a shot. With the addition of bassist John Deacon and Bulsara changing his name to Freddie Mercury, the band Queen is born - but the path to world domination is a bumpy one.

programme.title: Erin Brockovich
programme.desc: Oscar-winning biographical drama starring Julia Roberts. When she loses a lawsuit following a car accident, unemployed single mother Erin Brockovich browbeats her lawyer, Ed Masry, into giving her a job. Soon she discovers that a power company has been dumping toxic waste and poisoning the residents of a small town. Masry's firm takes up the case - making Brockovich the unlikely linchpin in one of corporate America's biggest ever lawsuits.

programme.title: The Post
programme.desc: Political thriller based on a true story, starring Meryl Streep and Tom Hanks. Kay Graham, publisher of The Washington Post, and editor Ben Bradlee must overcome their differences to bring the leaked Pentagon Papers - which reveal the extent of the US government's involvement in the Vietnam War - into the public eye.

programme.title: Valentine's Day
programme.desc: Romantic comedy featuring an ensemble cast including Anne Hathaway, Jessica Alba and Julia Roberts. The love life of a florist working on Valentine's Day is sent into a tailspin after he proposes to his girlfriend. Meanwhile, his best friend thinks she has met the man of her dreams, little realising he is already married. Will love lend a hand and save the day?

programme.title: Renegades
programme.desc: Navy Seals are tasked with salvaging Nazi gold that's stored in a bank vault at the bottom of a Bosnian lake. Action adventure, starring JK Simmons, Sullivan Stapleton and Charlie Bewley

programme.title: Mechanic: Resurrection
programme.desc: Action crime thriller starring Jason Statham, Jessica Alba and Tommy Lee Jones. When a retired hitman's new love is kidnapped, the killer is forced out of retirement to perform three successful assassinations to get her back.

programme.title: Apocalypse of Ice
programme.desc: Disaster movie starring Tom Sizemore. A pandemic-beleaguered world is hit by a vast storm that threatens to leave the Earth almost entirely encrusted in ice. Having found a cure for the virus, a virologist has just 24 hours to reach the safe zone.

programme.title: The Lost World

programme.desc: Live from Washington DC, Clive Myrie, Sumi Somaskanda and Caitríona Perry guide viewers through a decisive night in American politics with far-reaching implications for the world. As polls close and votes pour in across the country, the balance of power in Washington is at stake. Throughout the night, BBC News will bring viewers the latest results as they happen, along with expert analysis of the races, candidates and issues driving voters to the polls, from affordability and immigration to tariffs, international conflict and the growing impact of data centres on local communities. With correspondents reporting from across the United States and the world, plus Ros Atkins at the touchscreen breaking down turnout, voting trends and the shifting balance of power, BBC News will track every major development in real time.

programme.desc:

programme.title: Seòid a' Chidsin - The Kitchen Coves
SpeakGaelic
programme.desc:
Tha Joy Dunlop gar toirt tro na h-ath cheumannan airson ar misneachadh gus leantainn oirnn a bhith bruidhinn na Gàidhlig. Thairis air an t-sreath seo, bidh i a' dèiligeadh ri facail is abairtean air measgachadh de chuspairean co-cheangailte ri gach taobh de ar beatha. Leis gun do dh'ionnsaich i fhèin, bheir Joy dhuinn briathrachas a tha sìmplidh agus furasta a thuigsinn. Bidh stiùireadh ann cuideachd a thaobh a bhith a' cleachdadh abairtean, le eisimpleirean soilleir tro chòmhraidhean goirid.
Coinnichidh sinn ri luchd-ionnsachaidh èasgaidh, feadhainn a tha ag ionnsachadh as ùr, cuid a bha fileanta 's a sguir ga cleachdadh agus iadsan a th' air a bhith ag ionnsachadh fad bhliadhnaichean. Agus bidh Calum MacIlleathain a' toirt sealladh eile dhuinn air Alba is e ann an diofar àiteachan air feadh na dùthcha. Lorgar tuilleadh stuthan taic air-loidhne aig www.speakgaelic.scot agus ann an sreath phodcastan air BBC Sounds.
Joy Dunlop guides viewers through the next steps to inspire us to speak Gaelic. Throughout the series, she'll introduce words and phrases on a variety of everyday topics. A Gaelic learner herself, Joy supports us through pronunciation and vocabulary on topics such as friends, home, work and communication.
We meet diligent learners who have embraced speaking Gaelic, from new learners to lapsed native speakers and the on-off learners who have improved their language skills over the decades. The intrepid Calum Maclean takes us on adventures to hidden treasures around Scotland.
Supporting materials can be found online at www.speakgaelic.scot and in the SpeakGaelic podcasts on BBC Sounds.

programme.title: An Là (News)
programme.desc: Local, national and international news and information from BBC Alba

programme.title: Rùm Gu Rùm, Le Erica
programme.desc: Erica Macpherson transforms rooms, homes and businesses, demonstrating the process from architectural plans to trawling auction houses and shops for finishing touches

programme.title: Alba fon Talamh
programme.desc: Calum Maclean explores the underground sites of central Scotland. First, author Mairi Kidd introduces him to a lesser known history of Edinburgh below the city streets. Then he ventures under the busy platforms of Glasgow Central Station, where Calum discovers an atmospheric disused Victorian platform. In Dunoon, Calum gets help from his friend Kenny Rankin to access the Paper Caves and find out more about a story that dates back almost 350 years, connecting the Campbell clan with the site

programme.title: Rurachd (Foraging)
programme.desc:
Màiri Anna NicUalraig agus Liusaidh Cooke - An Còcaire Fiadhain - a' rùrachd airson tairbheartas nàdair. Tha an ditches aig an taigh as t-fhoghar, a' coimhead air an lath dhen bhliadhna far am bithear a' trusadh airson nam preasachan a chumas biadh ri duine tron gheamhradh. Tha Màiri Anna is Liusaidh a' giollachd dhuircean daraich airson flùr a dhèanamh dhiubh, tha iad a' lorg balagan fiaclach ann an Loch Aills, agus tha iad a' dèanamh air Ceann a' Ghiùthsaich air thòir air measan cùbhraidh nan aiteann. Agus tha iad a' gabhail cuairt a dh'Eilean Èisdeil, feuch an trus iad sìol milis, blasta Lus nam Buadh agus far a bheil iad a' beachdachadh air deifir bhuill de theaghlach phlanntrais nan curran.
Mary Ann Kennedy and Lucy Cooke - The Wild Cooke - forage for nature's bounty. The two are at home in autumn, looking at the half of the year where cupboards are stocked to see through the winter. Mary Ann and Lucy process acorns to make flour, forage for hedgehog mushrooms in Lochalsh, and head for Kingussie in search of fragrant juniper berries. They also take a trip to Easdale island to harvest sweet and tasty angelica seeds and consider the different members of the carrot plant family.
In Gaelic with English subtitles

She speaks to the Rev Iver Martin, who followed in his father's footsteps and became a minister, and who is now the Moderator of the Free Church of Scotland

Together with a young French couple, Richard embarks on a hazardous journey to reach the island, but will they really find paradise?

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats
programme.desc: Irreverent panel show hosted by Jimmy Carr, in which guests join team captains Rob Beckett and Aisling Bea to answer questions based on opinion polls. Aisling is joined by Rizzle Kicks' Jordan Stephens and comedian Desiree Burch, while Rob teams up with Loose Women panellist Ayda Field and comic Dane Baptiste

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown
programme.desc: Jimmy Carr hosts the comedy words and numbers quiz, with Sean Lock and Danny Dyer taking on Joe Wilkinson and Gabby Logan, while David O'Doherty joins Countdown's resident lexicographer Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner and Rachel Riley looks after the numbers and letters

programme.title: Taskmaster
programme.desc: The grand final arrives and the remaining contestants make one last attempt to win Greg Davies' enormous golden head after weeks of exhausting challenges. Ed Gamble, Jo Brand, Katy Wix and Rose Matafeo remain in contention while David Baddiel's hopes appear all but finished. As the final bizarre tasks unfold, Alex Horne prepares the statistics for the crowning of the next Taskmaster champion.

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: The Vitamin Shoppe's CEO Sharon M Leite goes undercover, learning new ways to achieve added growth for her brand and seeing how her operational changes are impacting the frontlines

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Laurent 'LT' Therivel, a proud Marine veteran who started as president and CEO of UScellular less than a year before his undercover mission, is intent on seeing how his new endeavours for brand growth are going

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Perfectionist Michelle and her husband, Bryan Adams tribute singer Russell, host first in Cheltenham, on a night when a budding bromance starts to develop. On night two Calum and fiancee Lydia have a rustic theme. While their food doesn't seem to quite hit the mark, Calum's impromptu am dram performances do. Finally, Jane and Paul's menu celebrates Jane's favourite things, but gets mixed reviews

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: A farmhouse menu competes with a Mexican feast with a twist and a Japanese menu in Gloucestershire. To top things off, there's a bizarre breakdancing demo at Jake and Helen's.

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: Self-conscious Richard choo-choo-chooses a first-class trip for bride Latrice on their wedding day. Will his plans live up to her grand expectations?

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: Romantic groom Ash wants to pull off the Most Romantic Wedding ever, but his bride-to-be Vicki shuns anything corny. Ash has really got his work cut out to win her around.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Brandi saves a loose pooch from oncoming traffic, Darrell's locker confirms his Magic Bullet Theory, while Kenny's unit serves up a shiny score.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: The buyers head to Arcadia, where Darrell gives and takes, Ivy's prospects soar, and Rene and Casey find a his & hers locker.

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Stephen J Cloobeck, chairman and CEO of hotel company Diamond Resorts International, becomes the first boss to go incognito at his own organisation for a second time. His mission is to rebuild a business that he has just purchased, Pacific Monarch Resorts, which has locations across the western US and Mexico. He disguises himself as an ex-construction worker who wants to open a boutique hotel, going the extra mile by having his ears pierced to complete the look

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Steve Greenbaum goes undercover among the workforce of his company PostNet, which offers design, printing and shipping services to small businesses. Posing as a failed motorcycle shop owner, he tries to find out how his staff are responding to firms that have been hit by the global recession

programme.title: America's Funniest Home Videos
programme.desc: Ten of the series' funniest video clips go head-to-head to win a $100,000 prize. Plus, golf gaffes and a woman who's distracted while she's texting

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: The Vegas women try their own bidding style, Brandi and Jarrod try to phone it in and Kenny and his brother show everyone that family comes second

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Rene steals the units. Mary's locker reveals a sticky past, and Justin demonstrates he can turn a small investment into a big return.

programme.title: Below Deck Down Under
programme.desc: Chef Tzarina's new sous chef Anthony struggles with her unique leadership style. Captain Jason isn't happy with his new bosun when the Katina nearly ends up in a collision

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay revisits three of the restaurants he tried to save, returning to Lido, Anna Vincenzo's and Le Bistro to find out whether his advice has been put to good use

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: The chef travels to Los Angeles to help La Frite, an outdated French restaurant that is failing to make any profits. His first step is to try to reconcile the feuding family members who run the business, and so devises a plan to bring them together by using secret filming

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown Christmas Special
programme.desc: Jimmy Carr hosts this festive edition of the comedy words and numbers quiz, with actress Kathy Burke and comedian Russell Howard joining team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson. Joe Lycett joins Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner, while Joe Wilkinson 'assists' maths whizz Rachel Riley at the letters and numbers board

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown: New Year Special
programme.desc: Jimmy Carr hosts the comedy words-and-numbers quiz, with a Hogmanay flavour. Jon Richardson and Richard Osman take on Johnny Vegas and Sara Pascoe. Meanwhile, David O'Doherty joins Countdown's resident lexicographer Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner to arbitrate over the players' collective efforts and Rachel Riley looks after the numbers and letters with Joe Wilkinson

programme.title: Taskmaster
programme.desc: The award-winning celebrity challenge comes to the Channel 4 network, with Greg Davies as the all-powerful Taskmaster and Alex Horne (the show's creator) as his sidekick, setting all manner of perplexing and downright extraordinary tasks for five contestants from the comedy world - Johnny Vegas, Katherine Parkinson, Daisy May Cooper, Mawaan Rizwan and Richard Herring. They'll be facing giant bears, disappearing cows and flying eggs as they begin their campaign to win the ultimate prize - Greg's golden head

programme.title: Nope
programme.desc: Sci-fi horror starring Daniel Kaluuya and Keke Palmer. Siblings OJ and Em Haywood have taken over their late father's California ranch, where they train horses for use in Hollywood productions. After a series of bizarre occurrences around their property, OJ and Em take measures to record and capture the source of the chaos: a monstrous UFO.

programme.title: Baby Ruby
programme.desc: Psychological horror starring Noémie Merlant and Kit Harington. Lifestyle influencer Jo and her husband Spencer are looking forward to the birth of their first child. But soon after baby Ruby arrives, Jo starts to believe that the newborn is angry with her, and she becomes increasingly distrustful of her husband and her neighbours.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes and the Secret Weapon
programme.desc: Mystery starring Basil Rathbone and Nigel Bruce. When a pioneering bombsight is developed during the Second World War for use against the Nazis, Sherlock Holmes tries to prevent it falling into the hands of his arch rival Professor Moriarty.

programme.title: Arabesque
programme.desc: Spy drama starring Sophia Loren and Gregory Peck. An American professor becomes involved in an espionage plot after being asked to decipher a coded message. He is told that the price he has to pay for cracking the code is his own death. His only hope is to escape, which he does with the beautiful Yasmin in tow, but can he really trust her?

programme.title: Broken Lance
programme.desc: Oscar-winning western starring Spencer Tracy and Robert Wagner. Rancher Matt Devereaux is obsessed with keeping his cattle empire together. But when he leads a raid on a copper mine to stop the pollution of his land, it leads to trouble for his youngest son, Joe.

programme.title: A Room with a View
programme.desc: Period drama based on the novel by EM Forster, starring Maggie Smith, Helena Bonham Carter, Denholm Elliott, Julian Sands and Daniel Day-Lewis. A young Englishwoman's first grand tour of Europe turns into an unexpectedly complicated journey of discovery. Arriving in Florence with her cousin as her chaperone, they take up their rooms at the Pensione Bertolini and begin to meet the other guests.

programme.title: Suffragette
programme.desc: Historical drama starring Carey Mulligan, Helena Bonham Carter and Meryl Streep. London, 1912: women campaigning for the right to vote are forced into increasingly desperate acts as the state continues to brutalise and oppress them. The struggle draws women from all walks of life to the female ranks, from seasoned political activist Emmeline Pankhurst to simple laundry worker Maud Watts.

programme.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Gary Oldman, Jason Clarke and Andy Serkis. With most of the human population wiped out, the world is now ruled by super-intelligent apes. But their chimp leader Caesar finds his loyalties divided when a small band of human survivors strike back.

programme.title: The Nature of Love
programme.desc: Sophia's comfortable life turns upside down the day she meets Sylvain, and she leaves everything for a new, burning passion. Romantic comedy, starring Magalie Lepine Blondeau, Pierre-Yves Cardinal, Francis-William Rheaume and Monia Chokri. In French, with English subtitles

programme.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring James Franco and Freida Pinto. When scientist Will Rodman's programme of drug experiments to find a cure for Alzheimer's disease is shut down he secretly takes an offspring from one of the chimpanzees he was using into his home and names him Caesar. Caesar has inherited the effects of the trial drug and begins to show remarkable intelligence, a development that will put him on a violent collision course with the humans who have abused him.

programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build
programme.desc: Nick Knowles meets midwife and kidney patient Sascha, who has to undergo intense dialysis sessions for hours on end, five days a week. Determined to help, the DIY SOS team, bolstered by the local tradespeople and volunteers of Welwyn Garden City, renovate her home to include a dedicated dialysis room, offering her the chance of many more years with her family

programme.title: DIY SOS: Veteran Street
programme.desc: Nick Knowles and the team return to Veterans Street in Manchester, where, in 2015, with the help of Prince William and Prince Harry, DIY SOS launched their most ambitious project yet - transforming a derelict street into a vibrant community for veterans and local people. programme.title: Killer Women with Piers Morgan
programme.desc: Journalist and TV personality Piers Morgan continues his travels across the USA, this time meeting two very different female murderers, both of whom killed someone they loved. First, he heads to Florida's largest female prison to visit Amanda Hutto, who is serving a life sentence for murdering her daughter. She was accused of deliberately 'dunking' her seven-year-old child as a punishment for being naughty, with her young son testifying against her at the murder trial. Next, he journeys to Texas, where he encounters Rhonda Glover, a former beauty queen and rodeo star who gunned down her lover in cold blood after their relationship spiralled into drug-fuelled obsession and paranoia

programme.title: Bangers & Cash
programme.desc: A rare 1980s Sierra Cosworth draws in a crowd of Ford fans, while a restorer delights buyers with his 1966 Sunbeam Rapier and Sarah takes a shine to a caravan.

programme.title: Bangers & Cash
programme.desc: Derek waxes lyrical about a pristine Jaguar XJ8 and a Ford Model T van tests his driving skills.

programme.title: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
programme.desc: Henry and Simon are on the Wirral. Simon has a crazy plan to turn a chain into a standard lamp. Henry picks up a 1963 Ford Anglia and gets it back to its best.

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo traces the early 20th-century roots of the Spanish Civil War, which divided his family and sent his father into exile. The former politician discovers a nation fractured at the time by social tensions and regional loyalties, which today offer a rich diversity of cultures to delight the tourist. After arriving in Majorca from Barcelona, Michael spoils himself enjoying spectacular scenic views aboard a 1912 vintage railway and a 1913 tram. He also gets trampled underfoot at the bottom of a Catalan 'people steeple' and learns to make the perfect paella

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: A chance to buy goods from the comfort of home

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo travels from the chateaux of the Loire Valley to the heart of the Champagne region at Reims, beginning in the city of Orleans in north-central France. Here, he follows his Bradshaw's guide to the magnificent stained-glass windows of the Cathedral of Sainte-Croix, which tell the story of the heroine of France, Joan of Arc. Later, Michael takes a spin around the track at Le Mans in a French-built car, before making his way to the capital city of Paris. East of Paris, Michael finishes this leg of his journey in style with a tour of the cellars at Domaine Pommery in Reims

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo ventures on a rail journey through Germany, guided by Bradshaw's Continental Railway Guide published in 1936. Starting in the vibrant city of Berlin, Michael visits the Museum of Modern Art in Berlin's Kreuzberg, where he sees how a leading artist of the era, George Grosz, warned of the rise of fascism in a haunting self-portrait. In the Schöneberg district of the capital, Michael researches the decadent night scene of the 1920s, and looks at how cabaret culture is being revived today. When he reaches Weimar, Michael investigates the beginnings of Bauhaus design and visits the movement's first building, before travelling onto Stuttgart, where he takes a ride in a high-performance Porsche to the manufacturer's Stuttgart headquarters

programme.title: The World at War
programme.desc: Acclaimed chronicle of the Second World War, beginning with an account of Hitler's ascent to power at a time when the Germans were stricken by humiliating military defeat, runaway inflation and economic depression. programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce presents the show from Eltham Palace in South London. Social rejection soon follows, leading his "happy feet" to be blamed for a colony-threatening fish famine. Determined to prove his worth, Mumble heads off on a perilous journey to discover the truth about what has happened to the fish stocks.
