programme.title: Yesterday
programme.desc: Fantasy comedy starring Himesh Patel and Lily James. Cycling home after a gig, aspiring musician Jack is hit by a bus during a strange power cut. He wakes up to find himself in a world where nobody has heard of the Beatles, so takes advantage of this by passing their songs off as his own. Success soon comes his way, but it threatens to come between him and his manager and best friend, Ellie.

programme.title: Mr Deeds
programme.desc: Remake of Frank Capra's comedy Mr Deeds Goes to Town, starring Adam Sandler and Winona Ryder. Longfellow Deeds lives an uncomplicated life as a pizza-shop owner and aspiring greetings-card writer in a tiny town. But his world is thrown into disarray when he inherits a fortune from an unknown uncle.

programme.title: Coming 2 America
programme.desc: As King Jaffe Joffer, ruler of the prosperous nation of Zamunda, takes his final breath, pampered crown prince Akeem faces a constitutional crisis without a male heir to ascend the throne. An elderly shaman unexpectedly discloses that Akeem has an illegitimate son in New York. Comedy, starring Eddie Murphy and Arsenio Hall

programme.title: Marmaduke
programme.desc: Canine comedy featuring the voice of Owen Wilson. When the family of irrepressible Great Dane Marmaduke moves to a new home in California, it all proves to be something of a culture shock for the hapless hound, who continues to wreak havoc wherever he goes.

programme.title: Zoolander
programme.desc: Satirical comedy starring Ben Stiller as Derek Zoolander, the vain, self-absorbed king of the male-modelling world. But Zoolander's fame and fortune are threatened when he's brainwashed into assassinating an eminent statesman whose proposed new child-labour laws would spell disaster for the fashion industry.

programme.title: Zoolander 2
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Ben Stiller, Owen Wilson and Penélope Cruz. Once-legendary catwalk icon Derek Zoolander is lured back into the fashion business by a beautiful agent investigating a spate of celebrity deaths.

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: Crime thriller directed by Guy Ritchie, and starring Jason Statham and Ray Liotta. Jake Green leaves prison determined to avenge the murder of his sister-in-law by men working for ruthless casino boss Dorothy Macha, the person also responsible for his incarceration. But after a confrontation at Macha's club, Green becomes a target for the villain's henchmen.

programme.title: One Last Deal
programme.desc: A veteran sports agent scrambles to land one last high-stakes deal for his star client, with both their futures on the line. Drama, starring Danny Dyer and Elliott Rogers

programme.title: Dirty Harry
programme.desc: Crime thriller starring Clint Eastwood. San Francisco cop "Dirty" Harry Callahan is assigned the case of a sniper who has murdered a young girl and threatened further killings if his ransom demand is not met. Dismayed to find himself partnered with a raw recruit, Callahan is soon at odds with his bosses over whether to pay off the killer.

programme.title: Kill
programme.desc: A train to New Delhi becomes a combat battleground as one spec-ops commando faces off against a terrorist militia to save his girlfriend. Hindi action, starring Lakshya, Raghav Juyal, Tanya Maniktala and Abhishek Chauhan

programme.title: Sharp Corner
programme.desc: Josh McCall is a family man who becomes obsessed with saving the lives of the car accident victims on the sharp corner in front of his house. It's an obsession that could cost him everything. Writer/director Jason Buxton's thriller, starring Ben Foster, Cobie Smulders and Gavin Drea

programme.title: RocknRolla
programme.desc: A Russian mob boss sets up a profitable real-estate scam in London and soon every criminal in the city is after their share. The gangster's accountant hires a trio of crooks to take his boss's millions, while a rock star with a penchant for faking his own death causes further mayhem by stealing a valuable painting. Guy Ritchie's crime comedy, starring Gerard Butler, Tom Wilkinson and Thandie Newton

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: Crime thriller directed by Guy Ritchie, and starring Jason Statham and Ray Liotta. Jake Green leaves prison determined to avenge the murder of his sister-in-law by men working for ruthless casino boss Dorothy Macha, the person also responsible for his incarceration. But after a confrontation at Macha's club, Green becomes a target for the villain's henchmen.

programme.title: The Bank Job
programme.desc: Heist thriller based on a true story, starring Jason Statham and Saffron Burrows. In 1970s London, Terry Leather, a car dealer with a dubious past, is approached by his glamorous former girlfriend Martine. She has a plan to steal safe deposit boxes from a top bank, and needs his help to organise the robbery. But the boxes contain more than just valuables, and Terry discovers that several dangerous individuals also want to get hold of them.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Cold War action thriller starring Sean Connery, Alec Baldwin and Scott Glenn. The trial voyage of new Soviet submarine Red October does not go as expected. Equipped with an experimental new propulsion system that makes it virtually impossible to track and captained by the enigmatic Marko Ramius, the heavily armed vessel heads for America. Is Ramius about to launch an undetectable, pre-emptive nuclear strike?

programme.title: Mr & Mrs Smith
programme.desc: Romantic action comedy starring Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie. Dissatisfied married couple John and Jane Smith live an outwardly respectable existence in suburbia, but they are soon shocked to discover their similar secret - they are both sophisticated professional assassins and their next lethal assignment is to kill one another.

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: Comedy crime drama starring Brad Pitt, Jason Statham and Benicio Del Toro. In Antwerp, jewel thief Franky Four Fingers steals a huge diamond, but before he can deliver it to his New York boss he is ambushed in London by a Russian mobster's henchmen. Elsewhere in the capital, crimelord Brick Top demands that Irish boxer Mickey One Punch take a dive in an unlicensed fight. When Brick Top joins the hunt for the missing gem, mayhem ensues.

programme.title: The Bank Job
programme.desc: Heist thriller based on a true story, starring Jason Statham and Saffron Burrows. In 1970s London, Terry Leather, a car dealer with a dubious past, is approached by his glamorous former girlfriend Martine. But the boxes contain more than just valuables, and Terry discovers that several dangerous individuals also want to get hold of them.

programme.title: Lifehack
programme.desc: Kyle and his friends spend their nights hacking for kicks, humiliating online scammers with elaborate digital pranks. But craving a bigger score, they set their sights on tech billionaire Don Heard, infiltrating his world through his daughter Lindsey's social media accounts. Thriller, starring Georgie Farmer and Yasmin Finney

programme.title: Valentine's Day
programme.desc: Romantic comedy featuring an ensemble cast including Anne Hathaway, Jessica Alba and Julia Roberts. The love life of a florist working on Valentine's Day is sent into a tailspin after he proposes to his girlfriend. Meanwhile, his best friend thinks she has met the man of her dreams, little realising he is already married. Will love lend a hand and save the day?

programme.title: Erin Brockovich
programme.desc: Oscar-winning biographical drama starring Julia Roberts. When she loses a lawsuit following a car accident, unemployed single mother Erin Brockovich browbeats her lawyer, Ed Masry, into giving her a job. Soon she discovers that a power company has been dumping toxic waste and poisoning the residents of a small town. Masry's firm takes up the case - making Brockovich the unlikely linchpin in one of corporate America's biggest ever lawsuits.

programme.title: Air
programme.desc: In 1984, Nike's basketball talent scout Sonny Vaccaro believes the company should invest its entire annual 250,000 US dollar budget in one prospect: 21-year-old NBA rookie Michael Jordan. Vaccaro travels to North Carolina to speak directly to Michael's parents Deloris and James. Drama starring Matt Damon, Viola Davis and Ben Affleck

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Nov 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: Oscar-winning western starring John Wayne as one-eyed US marshal "Rooster" Cogburn. When a young girl discovers that her father has been robbed and murdered, she persuades the hard-drinking Cogburn to track down the killer.

programme.title: The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Asa Butterfield, Jack Scanlon and David Thewlis. After his Nazi officer father is given a promotion, young Bruno and his family are moved from Berlin to a remote house in the countryside. With nothing to do and no friends of his own age, Bruno becomes curious about a nearby building known as "the farm" and its oddly clothed inhabitants.

programme.title: Hamlet
programme.desc: A grieving son returns to England to mourn his father, the CEO of Elsinore Property. The shell-shocked Hamlet learns plans are already afoot for his uncle Claudius to marry his mother Gertrude just days after losing her husband. Contemporary drama based on the Shakespeare classic, starring Riz Ahmed, Morfydd Clark, Joe Alwyn, Timothy Spall and Art Malik

programme.title: Jackie
programme.desc: Biographical drama starring Natalie Portman and Peter Sarsgaard. A week after the assassination of her husband, President John F Kennedy, a shell-shocked Jackie is interviewed by a journalist, and is forced to relive the events leading up to the most horrific moment of her life.

programme.title: Valentine's Day
programme.desc: Romantic comedy featuring an ensemble cast including Anne Hathaway, Jessica Alba and Julia Roberts. The love life of a florist working on Valentine's Day is sent into a tailspin after he proposes to his girlfriend. Meanwhile, his best friend thinks she has met the man of her dreams, little realising he is already married. Will love lend a hand and save the day?

programme.title: The Post
programme.desc: Political thriller based on a true story, starring Meryl Streep and Tom Hanks. Kay Graham, publisher of The Washington Post, and editor Ben Bradlee must overcome their differences to bring the leaked Pentagon Papers - which reveal the extent of the US government's involvement in the Vietnam War - into the public eye.

programme.title: Rocketman
programme.desc: Biographical musical drama starring Taron Egerton and Jamie Bell. From the safety of an addiction rehab group, a flamboyantly dressed man recalls the highs and lows of his childhood and transformation from talented young pianist Reggie Dwight into global superstar Elton John.

programme.title: A Star Is Born
programme.desc: Musical romantic drama starring Lady Gaga and Bradley Cooper. Rock star Jackson Maine meets aspiring songwriter Ally, a waitress who moonlights as a bar singer. Mesmerised by Ally's talent, Jackson invites her to perform with him and she becomes a sensation. The two begin a romantic relationship, but their happiness is threatened as an increasingly washed-up Jackson grapples with substance abuse issues.

programme.title: Hamlet
programme.desc: A grieving son returns to England to mourn his father, the CEO of Elsinore Property. Contemporary drama based on the Shakespeare classic, starring Riz Ahmed, Morfydd Clark, Joe Alwyn, Timothy Spall and Art Malik

programme.title: Gattaca
programme.desc: Science-fiction thriller starring Ethan Hawke, Uma Thurman and Jude Law. Vincent is an outsider, meaning that his birth was natural, making him "In-valid". The world in which he lives is ruled by "designer people" - that is, people forged in test tubes. He is only able to pursue his goal of a mission to space by buying prime genetic material from a "Valid" and forge a new identity. Then he meets Irene, another "Valid", but a week before his flight a Gattaca mission director is brutally murdered.

programme.title: The Shining
programme.desc: Stanley Kubrick's chilling horror, starring Jack Nicholson and Shelley Duvall. Aspiring writer and recovering alcoholic Jack Torrance takes on the job of winter caretaker at the remote Overlook Hotel, despite a warning about the psychological strain the long months of isolation can cause. Jack's wife Wendy only hopes that Jack will finally find the time to write, but his psychically gifted son Danny has visions of a terrifying ordeal for the family.

programme.title: Event Horizon
programme.desc: A deep-space salvage crew investigate mysterious events aboard a hi-tech spaceship, which suddenly reappeared in orbit around Neptune after going missing for seven years - but it is not long before they are exposed to terror beyond their wildest nightmares. Sci-fi horror, starring Laurence Fishburne, Sam Neill, Kathleen Quinlan, Joely Richardson and Sean Pertwee

programme.title: Green Lantern
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure based on the comic book series, starring Ryan Reynolds. Cocky test pilot Hal Jordan is inducted into an intergalactic peacekeeping force when he inherits a ring from an alien race that endows him with superpowers.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Supernatural horror based on Stephen King's novel, starring Jason Clarke, Amy Seimetz and John Lithgow. Shortly after the Creed family move to a new town, their cat is killed in a traffic accident. Neighbour Jud suggests they lay the animal to rest in an ancient woodland burial ground. When the family is rocked by tragedy, though, events take a macabre turn.

programme.title: The Last Starfighter
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Lance Guest and Dan O'Herlihy. Alex is a bored teenager who lives with his mother and young brother in a trailer park. The chance for adventure comes when Starfighter, the video game he plays, becomes reality.

programme.title: Beast of War
programme.desc: A group of soldiers get stranded on a raft in the middle of the ocean after their ship is sunk, and must battle a great white shark. Writer/director Kiah Roache-Turner's horror thriller, starring Mark Coles Smith and Joel Nankervis

With only a few weeks before his mission is due to end, Jack's concept of reality comes crashing down after he rescues a stranger from a downed spacecraft.

Thomas leaves his bride Ellen in the care of friend Friedrich Harding and his wife Anna. The young man barely survives the exhausting trip to Europe and stumbles home to find Ellen driven to delirium by a telepathic bond to the Count. Director Robert Eggers' version of the Dracula-inspired horror, starring Bill Skarsgard, Lily-Rose Depp, Nicholas Hoult and Aaron Taylor-Johnson

programme.desc: Sophia's comfortable life turns upside down the day she meets Sylvain, and she leaves everything for a new, burning passion. Romantic comedy, starring Magalie Lepine Blondeau, Pierre-Yves Cardinal, Francis-William Rheaume and Monia Chokri. In French, with English subtitles

programme.title: It's All About Love
programme.desc: Sci-fi love story starring Joaquin Phoenix and Claire Danes. John and his wife Elena, a world famous ice-skater, have lived apart for several years. Finally deciding to end their marriage, John pays a flying visit to New York to get Elena to sign their divorce papers. But when she fails to turn up, he begins to suspect her celebrity lifestyle is not what it seems. As strange and unexpected events start to unfold, John realises that Elena actually needs him more than ever before.

programme.desc: Romantic period adventure starring Heath Ledger. In 14th-century Europe, William, a young commoner, poses as Sir Ulric of Liechtenstein, a knight. But can he change his lowly destiny by winning jousting tournaments, or will the evil Count Adhemar discover the deception before William can win the fair Lady Jocelyn's hand?

programme.title: US Midterm Elections 2026
programme.desc: Live from Washington DC, Clive Myrie, Sumi Somaskanda and Caitríona Perry guide viewers through a decisive night in American politics with far-reaching implications for the world. As polls close and votes pour in across the country, the balance of power in Washington is at stake. Throughout the night, BBC News will bring viewers the latest results as they happen, along with expert analysis of the races, candidates and issues driving voters to the polls, from affordability and immigration to tariffs, international conflict and the growing impact of data centres on local communities. With correspondents reporting from across the United States and the world, plus Ros Atkins at the touchscreen breaking down turnout, voting trends and the shifting balance of power, BBC News will track every major development in real time.

programme.desc:
The Squirrels are playing hide-and-seek and come across a pink snorting fluffy animal - a Scrufflelump!
The Squirrels are excited and want to keep the Scrufflelump as their pet, but Duggee is wary. Keeping a pet is a lot of work. They need feeding, cleaning, exercising and much more that will keep you very busy. But they are wonderful too and can bring a lot of love to life. Duggee lets the Squirrels know the Clubhouse is not quite ready for another animal, so the Squirrels and Duggee wave Potato goodbye.
Just as the Squirrels are starting to miss Potato, who do they spot? Potato! It's followed them home! The Squirrels take up their responsibilities and feed, wash and exercise Potato, but Duggee was right and minding a pet is very tiring work.
Just then, there's a knock on the Clubhouse door. A family of Scrufflelumps are standing outside. The Squirrels are confused as these Scrufflelumps can speak just like them and not with the incoherent noises that Potato makes.
They ask if the Squirrels have seen their dad. The Squirrels are very confused until Potato coughs and spits and says yes to them. Potato is the Scrufflelump family dad! Potato packs up and leaves, and the Squirrels learn a valuable lesson about how to take care of a pet.

programme.desc: The clownfish reveals how they live on sea anemone, how they keep the sea anemone clean and how the sea anemone keep them safe from predators

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Donald Smith reads Beatha Dhìomhair Tìgeir by Emilia Dziubak, illustrated by Przemyslaw Wechterowicz and translated into Gaelic by Donald John MacLeod

programme.title: Belle agus Sebastian
programme.desc: When Cameron comes across a black eagle's egg, he stubbornly wants to keep it for himself. The gang sets out to try to return the egg to the nest and keep it safe

programme.title: Seonaidh (Shaun the Sheep)
programme.desc:
Tha an tuathanach a' co-dhùnadh gu bheil an t-àm ann fàs fallain - agus tha e ag iarraidh Bitzer a thoirt a-steach air cùisean. Tha beachd eile aig Bitzer ge-tà agus tha e a' tighinn an àrd le plana dìomhair gus an obair chruaidh a sheachnadh. An dèan an sgeama aige a' chùis aig a' cheann thall?
The farmer decides it is time to get fit and calls on Bitzer to join him. Bitzer has other ideas and comes up with a secret plan to avoid putting in the hard work. Will his scheme catch up with him in the end?

programme.title: Aidan: Balach Beag Muay Thai
programme.desc: Aidan, a 10-year-old boy from Scotland prepares for the biggest fight of his life as he competes in the WBC World Muay Thai festival. This documentary follows his journey as he practises his Muay Thai technique with his coach, who is also his mother, as well as working on building his endurance so he will be able to compete in multiple fights.

programme.title: Flix
programme.desc: Flix and Munchkin devote themselves to helping Tabi find her voice again and overcome her stage fright at a school talent show

programme.title: A’ Chùil
programme.desc:
Tha Choirstaidh air ais le prògram eile bhon stiùidio aice, A' Chùil. Sa phrògram seo seallaidh i dhut dòigh sgoinneil air coltas eadar-dhealaichte a thoirt air do chuid aodaich!
Choirstaidh presents from her studio A' Chùil to show you a great way of changing up your clothes.

programme.title: Golf: Mun Cuairt Alba
programme.desc: An aerial journey around a selection of golf courses in the Western Isles, and the story of the historic golf course at Askernish in South Uist

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc:
Tha Joy Dunlop gar toirt tron tuilleadh cheumannan airson ar misneachadh gus leantainn oirnn a bhith bruidhinn na Gàidhlig. Thairis air an t-sreath seo, bidh i a' dèiligeadh ri facail is abairtean air measgachadh de chuspairean co-cheangailte ri gach taobh de ar beatha. Leis gun do dh'ionnsaich i fhèin a' chànan, bheir Joy dhuinn briathrachas a tha sìmplidh agus furasta a thuigsinn. Bidh stiùireadh ann cuideachd a thaobh a bhith a' cleachdadh abairtean, le eisimpleirean soilleir tro chòmhraidhean goirid.
Coinnichidh sinn ri luchd-labhairt èasgaidh, feadhainn a tha ag ionnsachadh as ùr, cuid a bha fileanta agus a sguir ga cleachdadh agus iadsan a th' air a bhith ag ionnsachadh fad bhliadhnaichean. Agus bidh Calum MacIlleathain a' toirt sealladh eile dhuinn air Alba 's e ann an diofar àitichean air feadh na dùthcha. Lorgar tuilleadh stuthan taic air-loidhne aig www.speakgaelic.scot agus ann an sreath phodcastan air BBC Sounds.
Joy Dunlop guides viewers through the next steps to inspire us to speak Gaelic. Throughout the series, she introduces words and phrases on a variety of everyday topics. A Gaelic learner herself, Joy will support us through pronunciation and vocabulary on topics such as friends, home, work, communication and people's skills.
We meet diligent speakers who have embraced the language, from new learners to lapsed native speakers and the on-off learners who have improved their language skills over the decades. And, the intrepid Calum Maclean takes us on adventures to hidden treasures around Scotland.
Supporting materials can be found online: www.speakgaelic.scot and in the SpeakGaelic podcasts on BBC Sounds.

programme.desc: Local, national and international news and information from BBC Alba

programme.title: Rathad Ramsay
programme.desc: Ramsay meets singer Mary Ann Kennedy in Ardgour. Although born in Glasgow, Mary Ann discusses how she has made her home in Ardgour and what that means to her. As they walk along Cona Glen, Mary Ann opens up about feeling comfortable in her own skin and how the environment has helped her find peace. She chats about her changing relationship with music and what brings her happiness

programme.title: Am Balla
programme.desc: Ramsay MacMahon goes on a journey to find out about the border between Spain and Morocco. In Ceuta a high fence separates Africa and Europe and for many, this is the gateway to Europe. Ramsay meets migrants who have risked everything to cross the wall in the hope of a better life. He hears from local residents who live with the political tensions and meets people who work to help the most vulnerable

programme.title: Ath-thogail Notre-Dame (Rebuilding Notre-Dame)
programme.desc: Built in the 12th Century in the centre of Paris, Notre-Dame was once the world's highest cathedral. This gigantic stone structure is the very essence of Gothic architecture. Today, its stability is compromised as the 2019 fire greatly damaged the building's structure. Its roof was completely destroyed, as well as its incredible wooden frame, made of a thousand oaks, which was swallowed by the flames. Scientists and architects study the impressive skeleton of wood and metal which hid behind the stone. Supported by 3D animations as well as re-enactments, their interventions make it possible to grasp the genesis of this monumental structure

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: In this revisit episode, chef Gordon Ramsay goes back to Mojito, the Junction (formerly known as Flamangos) and Bazzini to check in with the owners he helped in the past and find out whether his advice has been put to good use. Will he be pleased with their progress?

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown
programme.desc: Jimmy Carr hosts the comedy version of the words-and-numbers quiz, with Sean Lock and Stephen Mangan teaming up against Noel Fielding and Fay Ripley. The Brett Domino Trio are in Dictionary Corner with Susie Dent, while Rachel Riley looks after the numbers and letters

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown
programme.desc: Jimmy Carr hosts the comedy words-and-numbers quiz, with Jon Richardson and Phil Wang taking on guest captain Russell Howard and Roisin Conaty. Nick Helm joins Countdown's resident lexicographer Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner and Rachel Riley looks after the numbers and letters

programme.title: Taskmaster
programme.desc: Alex Horne sets more tricky, puzzling and downright idiotic challenges for the celebrities, before Greg Davies decides who deserves the most points. Highlights include Johnny Vegas yelling from a tall chair, Katherine Parkinson forgetting how balloons work and Richard Herring flailing about in a dinghy. It remains to be seen what Daisy May Cooper and Mawaan Rizan will be doing - but it's unlikely to be dignified

programme.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Gary Oldman, Jason Clarke and Andy Serkis. With most of the human population wiped out, the world is now ruled by super-intelligent apes. But their chimp leader Caesar finds his loyalties divided when a small band of human survivors strike back.

programme.title: The Nature of Love
programme.desc: Sophia's comfortable life turns upside down the day she meets Sylvain, and she leaves everything for a new, burning passion. Romantic comedy, starring Magalie Lepine Blondeau, Pierre-Yves Cardinal, Francis-William Rheaume and Monia Chokri. In French, with English subtitles

programme.title: It's All About Love
programme.desc: Sci-fi love story starring Joaquin Phoenix and Claire Danes. John and his wife Elena, a world famous ice-skater, have lived apart for several years. Finally deciding to end their marriage, John pays a flying visit to New York to get Elena to sign their divorce papers. But when she fails to turn up, he begins to suspect her celebrity lifestyle is not what it seems. As strange and unexpected events start to unfold, John realises that Elena actually needs him more than ever before.

programme.title: Gun Fury
programme.desc: Western starring Rock Hudson and Donna Reed. When his fiancée Jennifer is kidnapped by outlaw Frank Slayton, rancher Ben Warren sets out on their trail with Slayton's embittered ex-partner.

programme.title: The Admirable Crichton
programme.desc: Comedy adventure based on the play by JM Barrie, starring Kenneth More. A butler finds that his common-sense values give him the upper hand over his aristocratic employer when they are marooned on a tropical island.

programme.title: The Ghost and Mrs Muir
programme.desc: Romantic fantasy starring Gene Tierney as a widow who befriends the mischievous ghost of a sea captain (Rex Harrison) when she moves into the isolated coastal house where he used to live.

programme.title: The True Story of Jesse James
programme.desc: Western starring Robert Wagner and Jeffrey Hunter. Infamous outlaw Jesse James and his gang are cornered in a swamp following a failed bank raid. As James prepares to shoot his way to freedom, the story of his life of violence and crime is told by his family and loved ones.

programme.title: A Knight's Tale
programme.desc: Romantic period adventure starring Heath Ledger. In 14th-century Europe, William, a young commoner, poses as Sir Ulric of Liechtenstein, a knight. But can he change his lowly destiny by winning jousting tournaments, or will the evil Count Adhemar discover the deception before William can win the fair Lady Jocelyn's hand?

programme.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure sequel starring Woody Harrelson and Andy Serkis. In the third instalment of the rebooted franchise, ape leader Caesar embarks on a quest for revenge after the crazed Colonel McCullough kills Caesar's family in a bid to assassinate him.

programme.title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
programme.desc: Five cookie makers make trendy tie-dye cookies. Then, they decorate cookies that resemble savoury holiday appetisers, but must use classic crudité ingredients.

programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship
programme.desc: Jesse Palmer asks the ten bakers to highlight a nut or seed in a holiday dessert. Next, the competitors must use a holiday ingredient in unseasonable desserts.

programme.title: Santa's Baking Blizzard
programme.desc: Baking competition series hosted by Casey Webb. Casey challenges three teams of bakers to create fantasy snow globe cakes

programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship: Gingerbread
programme.desc: The teams create a holiday light show out of gingerbread. They pair their creations with the lightest of desserts, choux pastry.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Today, Andrew Denly and wife Sheila from Sussex are hoping clockmaker Steve Fletcher can fix a vintage boy's toy with big memories attached. It's an antique toy cannon handed down to Andrew by his grandfather, who bought it with his pocket money in 1907. Andrew fondly describes his grandfather as his inspiration and boyhood hero. The little cannon is much treasured but hasn't worked in over 50 years. Steve must use all his ingenuity to get it firing once more.
A Victorian oddity is brought to the attention of leather expert Susie Fletcher. Sisters Pam and Frances are hoping Suzie can revive a novelty inkwell in the shape of a hat. It is a treasured family heirloom as it had huge sentimental value to the sisters' mother. After years of vigorous overuse, the button mechanism no longer works and it is missing its leather covering. Suzie drafts in sibling Steve Fletcher to help make a missing part, and she discovers a new talent for miniature millinery as she returns the inkwell to its stylish former glory.
Finally, ceramics expert Kirstin Ramsey prays for divine intervention as she tries to rebuild a saintly statue. Caroline Morson and Professor John Northover have come to the barn seeking help resurrecting an important icon that's been a symbol of hope to many: a statue of St Fiacre, the patron saint of gardeners and haemorrhoid victims! The statue has been a landmark in the garden of St Mark's Hospital, a centre for the treatment of bowel disease, for many years, but has been vandalised and is now broken in two. Gifted to the hospital by Caroline's father, renowned pathologist Dr Basil Morson, staff and patients alike are keen to see St Fiacre restored and back on duty. By far one of the biggest projects Kirsten has had on her bench, she must clean and reunite the two large broken halves, creating an imperceptible join to breathe new life into this old saint.

programme.desc: A jealous Leonard argues with Penny when she invites one of her male friends to stay at her apartment while he is in town. programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Howard's fear of commitment causes him to avoid Bernadette, but he soon realises he has made a mistake and tries to compensate for it. Meanwhile, Kripke plays a prank during a radio interview with Sheldon, who sets out to get revenge, only to be caught by the Dean. Johnny Galecki, Simon Helberg and Kaley Cuoco star, with an appearance by Katee Sackhoff (Battlestar Galactica) as herself

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Bernadette asks Leonard about his physics experiment, making Howard so jealous that she threatens to end their relationship. Penny also feels put out by the situation, and asks Sheldon to teach her about science. Johnny Galecki, Simon Helberg and Melissa Rauch star

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Leonard's mother visits and he is horrified to learn that Sheldon knows more than he does about his own family, including his parents' impending divorce and the death of his dog. Guest starring Christine Baranski

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Raj lusts after a girl he and Sheldon meet at a university party, and Leonard comes to regret airing his disapproval of Penny's belief in psychics. Comedy, starring Kunal Nayyar and Jim Parsons

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Leonard and Sheldon's flat is burgled, so they work on a state-of-the-art security system in a bid to outwit any future would-be thieves. However, their plans go awry when they ensnare Penny in a net. Comedy, starring Johnny Galecki and Jim Parsons

programme.title: Body Bizarre
programme.desc: Natalia was born with a rare condition referred to as the 'vanishing bone disease'. Sanja has a condition that causes blisters to form on her skin. In Ohio, Tiffany, 41, was diagnosed with progeria when she was in her late twenties.

programme.title: Body Bizarre
programme.desc: After having her leg amputated, Jillian has surgery which will allow her to use her ankle as her knee. In Peachtree City, USA, Ashley Kurpiel suffers from a rare condition that turns her muscles to bone.

programme.title: Coffy
programme.desc: A dedicated nurse vows revenge after her drug addicted sister is nearly killed by a dose of contaminated heroin. Grabbing a shotgun, she takes to the streets to rid her city of drug pushers once and for all. Blaxploitation thriller, starring Pam Grier, Robert DoQui and Booker Bradshaw

programme.title: Edwardian Farm
programme.desc: It is July and Alex Langlands, Peter Ginn and Ruth Goodman face their busiest period of the year as harvest arrives. The team brings in the cherries with the help of the Dartmoor pony, Ruth tries her hand at salmon netting, and Alex and Peter struggle to save their potato crop from being wiped out by plant disease. There is also time to relax after all the hard work with a day out at the seaside, featuring musical entertainment, new-fangled swimming costumes and a Punch and Judy show

programme.title: Flipping Profit
programme.desc: Antiques auctioneer Charles Hanson, top trader Linda Lambert and trendy upcycler Zoe Pocock head to Glastonbury to find some bargains they can turn into some flipping profit. Rummaging through antique shops, scrap yards and flea markets, they only have one day to each find those hidden second-hand or used gems that will make them a nice big profit

programme.title: Edwardian Farm
programme.desc: Constant rain threatens the harvesting of the oat crop so Peter Ginn tries to fashion a weather vane in the hope of predicting future conditions, before the team deploys the latest in farming technology, including a tractor and an Edwardian film crew captures progress. The town enjoys a grand fete where new innovations of the era such as the electric lightbulb, the petrol-powered Lister engine and a genuine flying machine are showcased

programme.title: Clive Myrie's Italian Road Trip
programme.desc:
Clive heads north from Lazio's capital, Rome, to the dramatic valleys of Italy's badlands, out of which rises the fairy-tale citadel of Civita di Bagnoregio - Lazio's ghost town.
Meeting one of the 20 remaining residents, Clive finds out what it's like to be outnumbered by a million annual visitors, and he explores the ancient tunnels beneath the town to discover why it's slowly crumbling to dust.

programme.title: Killer Women with Piers Morgan
programme.desc: Journalist and TV personality Piers Morgan continues his travels across the USA, this time meeting two very different female murderers, both of whom killed someone they loved. First, he heads to Florida's largest female prison to visit Amanda Hutto, who is serving a life sentence for murdering her daughter. She was accused of deliberately 'dunking' her seven-year-old child as a punishment for being naughty, with her young son testifying against her at the murder trial. Next, he journeys to Texas, where he encounters Rhonda Glover, a former beauty queen and rodeo star who gunned down her lover in cold blood after their relationship spiralled into drug-fuelled obsession and paranoia

programme.title: DIY SOS: Million Pound Build for Children in Need
programme.desc: As part of the 2013 appeal, Nick Knowles and the team head to Peterborough to help Children in Need-funded organisation Little Miracles, which supports youngsters with disabilities and life-limiting illnesses and their families. However, whereas Mark, Chris, Julian and Billy normally renovate an existing property, for the first time they are knocking down a building and reconstructing it from the ground up - making it worth almost £1million. With just nine days to complete the job, they'll need help - and lots of it. Luckily, tradespeople turn out in force - from both the local area and across the country - giving their time for free

programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build
programme.desc: In the summer of 2015, West Sussex wife and mother-of-four Amanda fell off her bike while training for an endurance contest, breaking 11 bones, puncturing a lung, and snapping her collarbone and back. Paralysed, she spent the next six months at Stoke Mandeville's spinal unit, while her builder husband Vic looked after the children - but determined to compete again, she returned home in a wheelchair. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the greater the prize fund. The player who has won the least amount is then eliminated, and the last one standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot

programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build
programme.desc: The building crusaders come to the aid of 12-year-old Matthew from Telford, Shropshire, who has been stuck in hospital for three years after suffering cancer and a stroke. The youngster's head teacher and school friends have been fundraising to get him home, so now, Nick Knowles and the team - with the help of hundreds of volunteers - set out to make Matthew's home suitable for his complex medical needs

programme.title: DIY SOS: Million Pound Build for Children in Need
programme.desc: As part of the 2013 appeal, Nick Knowles and the team head to Peterborough to help Children in Need-funded organisation Little Miracles, which supports youngsters with disabilities and life-limiting illnesses and their families. However, whereas Mark, Chris, Julian and Billy normally renovate an existing property, for the first time they are knocking down a building and reconstructing it from the ground up - making it worth almost £1million. With just nine days to complete the job, they'll need help - and lots of it. Luckily, tradespeople turn out in force - from both the local area and across the country - giving their time for free

programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build
programme.desc: In the summer of 2015, West Sussex wife and mother-of-four Amanda fell off her bike while training for an endurance contest, breaking 11 bones, puncturing a lung, and snapping her collarbone and back. Paralysed, she spent the next six months at Stoke Mandeville's spinal unit, while her builder husband Vic looked after the children - but determined to compete again, she returned home in a wheelchair. However, the family home is no longer suitable for Amanda - so that's where Nick Knowles and the rest of the DIY SOS team come in, strengthened by a number of local tradesmen

A fast-response car is dispatched when a three-year-old is hit by a vehicle, and Andy joins the police when a 13-year-old is stabbed on the way home from school

programme.title: Killer Women with Piers Morgan
programme.desc: Broadcaster and journalist Piers Morgan travels across the USA to meet some of America's most notorious female murderers, in a quest to discover what drives a woman to kill. He travels to Lowell Correctional Institute in Florida to talk to Rebecca Fenton, convicted for the murder of her husband Larry, who was shot dead in their home. He also looks into the details of the case, learning how for several years it seemed she was going to get away with the crime, until the involvement of the FBI helped bring her to justice

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo travels from the chateaux of the Loire Valley to the heart of the Champagne region at Reims, beginning in the city of Orleans in north-central France. Here, he follows his Bradshaw's guide to the magnificent stained-glass windows of the Cathedral of Sainte-Croix, which tell the story of the heroine of France, Joan of Arc. Later, Michael takes a spin around the track at Le Mans in a French-built car, before making his way to the capital city of Paris. East of Paris, Michael finishes this leg of his journey in style with a tour of the cellars at Domaine Pommery in Reims

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: On a railway journey from the capital Palermo, through the ancient town of Agrigento and the port of Siracusa, to Europe's largest volcano, Mount Etna, Michael Portillo explores Sicilian life under the dictatorship. He also finds out how the dictator took on the Mafia and asks whether it is true that under Mussolini, the trains ran on time

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo travels by train through Austria and the Czech Republic, beginning in the northern Austrian city of Linz, where Adolf Hitler lived as a young boy. From here, Michael travels onto Prague Central Station, where he meets 87-year-old Zuzana Maresova, who, as a seven-year-old girl climbed aboard a train to travel to safety in London with hundreds of other Jewish children. Eventually crossing the Czech border into Slovakia, Michael reaches his final destination, one of Europe's youngest capital cities, Bratislava

programme.title: Escaping Idi Amin
programme.desc: Part two of two. In September 1972, one month after Idi Amin announces his plan to expel all Ugandan Asians from the country, 80,000 people are making plans to flee, in fear for their lives. In the UK, controversial politician Enoch Powell rallies those who say the Ugandan Asians have no right to come, and some councils try to steer new arrivals away from their cities. Amin refuses to negotiate, stepping up the pressure on those stuck in the country

programme.title: The Book That Changed My Life
programme.desc: Inspired by her passion to get people reading, Queen Camilla joins four remarkable people to share the stories of books that shaped them. Warm, emotional and full of hope, the programme shows how reading can lift people up, open minds and even change lives in a celebration of the power inside every book

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: The actress explores the history, food and culture of Brittany with her Breton guide Tanguy Thomassin , heading to the vast oyster beds of Cancale, with the region still supplying half of France with the seafood. Brittany also boasts plentiful sardines, kelp forests, spiny crabs and the rare cobalt blue lobster

programme.title: The Bidding Room
programme.desc: Nigel Havers and Simon Bower relax into a pair of comfy club chairs. Jane has a personal connection to a curious piece of furniture, and one item has the dealers playing house

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Maisie Adam, Ade Edmondson, Rickie Haywood-Williams and Sammi Kinghorn take part, while Michael Sheen asks the questions

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Adam Frost updates on his garden as the growing season ends, and in the Peak District, Rekha Mistry advises on vegetables. Rachel de Thame celebrates chrysanthemums in Nottinghamshire, a mother and daughter discuss Japanese maples, and Advolly Richmond explores Blenheim Palace's garden history

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Politics Live
programme.desc: The latest stories from Westminster and beyond

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc:
Game show in which 30 players compete across the series, scoring points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.
In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

programme.title: The Answer Run
programme.desc: Jason Manford hosts the fast-paced quiz show where three couples face a series of 50/50 questions which hurtle down the Answer Run towards them

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: Sean Fletcher explores the food festival at Llangollen, where local food experts reveal their passion for their produce. Farmer Jim Smith tests his tastebuds with some hot sauces in Edinburgh, chef Suzie Lee discovers the key to producing cider in Armagh, and the secrets behind making a homemade pie on a budget are revealed

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo visits Leuchars, known nowadays on the railways as Leuchars for St Andrews, which is Scotland's oldest university.

programme.title: Secrets of the Aquarium
programme.desc: The Princess of Wales makes a surprise visit, there is concern for a new arrival, and Florence the shark takes a pregnancy test

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team examine the public's treasures brought for their scrutiny to Lampeter in Ceredigion. Objects valued include a bust of celebrated Welsh writer Dylan Thomas, an early book of silhouettes and a plate bought by its owner for a mere £5 that turns out to be worth £10,000. Originally shown in 2005

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: At Blackburn Cathedral, Charles Hanson values a rare Eureka clock and Anita Manning is drawn to four oil paintings of the Ribble Valley. Host Paul Martin meets up with Michelin-star chef Nigel Haworth to discover how to make the perfect Lancashire hotpot

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Maisie Adam, Ade Edmondson, Rickie Haywood-Williams and Sammi Kinghorn take part in the penultimate round of challenges. Michael Sheen asks the questions

programme.title: Strictly: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor is joined by more couples to dish up all the action from the world of Strictly Come Dancing. Plus, costume designer Vicky Gill reveals some of the weekend's outfits

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Jules Hudson is in the Welsh Borders, showcasing some tempting houses to a retired couple who have a whopping £1 million to spend. Along with a characterful property, they're after somewhere with holiday-let potential or space for a glamping business. Jules is also in his element when he meets experts in traditional construction methods who are keeping heritage building skills alive

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don travels across one of the widest parts of Britain, from the western Atlantic coast in Wales through the hilly Midlands and down to the low-lying eastern coast of Norfolk, which has some of the lowest rainfall in the country. Here, Monty visits places that have influenced how people garden - small, deeply loved spaces, and gardens that bankrupted their owners - and sees how intensely personal British gardens can be and how they reflect some of the greatest passions as well as some real eccentricities

programme.title: Rise of the Rockstar Chef
programme.desc: Documentary charting the rise of three of Britain's most influential culinary figures, Marco Pierre White, Gordon Ramsay and Heston Blumenthal. This first helping explores how Marco challenged French-dominated kitchens in the 1980s, transforming British gastronomy, setting standards for Gordon and Heston. Contributors include Marcus Wareing, Michel Roux Jr, Angela Hartnett, Clare Smyth and Tom Kerridge

programme.title: QI
programme.desc: Sandi Toksvig looks at extra-large and extra-small topics, with Desiree Burch, Gyles Brandreth, Sheila Hancock and Alan Davies

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Analysis of the day's events with Paddy O'Connell

programme.title: Highland Cops
programme.desc: Police race to intercept a suspected drugs courier heading for Inverness station with a large suitcase, which is found to contain a huge quantity of cannabis. In Glencoe, officers hunt for a missing hotel worker feared to be in crisis, while a routine visit to check on a man escalates into a siege when he threatens to burn his home down

programme.title: Ambulance: Code Red
programme.desc: At Reading Services on the M4, 72-year-old retired college lecturer Steve steps out of his car and suffers a cardiac arrest. Critical care paramedic Barry Walsh and Dr Henry Knott are despatched

programme.title: Weatherman Walking: Dylan's Walks: New Quay & Laugharne
programme.desc: Derek Brockway presents the second of two specials originally shown to celebrate the centenary of Dylan Thomas's birth. First he travels to the seaside town of New Quay on Cardigan Bay, where the poet and writer lived with wife Caitlin during the Second World War. Jeff Towns, chairman of the Dylan Thomas Society, joins Derek to explain how Thomas was inspired to write some of his greatest work during this era. For his final walk, to Laugharne, the presenter is accompanied by Thomas's grandaughter Hannah Ellis, who reveals the significance of the town to both her grandparents and her family today

programme.title: Secrets of Skin

Deadly Pit Vipers use heat sensors to ambush the small rodents they feed on. Ben Garrod puts them to the test with an experiment to see if they will strike a cold or warm ping-pong ball. programme.title: Reminders of Him

She is grimly resolved to confront ghosts of the past so she can finally meet the daughter she was forced to give up. Drama, starring Maika Monroe

Jason Bourne is rescued from the Mediterranean with bullet wounds in his back and suffering from amnesia. When he regains consciousness, he discovers that the only clue to his identity is a laser device under his skin, which reveals the name of a Zurich bank and the numbers of a Swiss bank account.

programme.desc: Spy action thriller, starring Matt Damon, Julia Stiles and Joan Allen. When an article about a covert CIA operation appears in The Guardian, trained assassin Jason Bourne sets off for London to meet the journalist behind the exposé who may be able to shed light on Bourne's past. But his former employers are also on the trail with instructions to make sure that the meeting never happens.

programme.title: The Bourne Legacy
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Jeremy Renner, Rachel Weisz and Edward Norton. As the CIA's covert operations are compromised and details are leaked to the media, intelligence chiefs decide to cut their losses and kill every agent testing their top secret genetic experiment. Agent Aaron Cross manages to escape the onslaught, but must contact the scientist behind Operation Outcome to maintain his enhanced functions and foil his handlers.

In London, during the weeks leading up to Christmas, people from various walks of life - among them adult film performers, a washed-up rock star and the British Prime Minister - suffer the emotional highs and lows of being in love.

programme.title: The Holiday
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Cameron Diaz, Kate Winslet, Jude Law and Jack Black. After breaking up with her boyfriend, Los Angeles workaholic Amanda is in need of a holiday. An online search persuades her to exchange her California home over Christmas for the remote Surrey cottage of journalist Iris, who has just found out her ex is getting married. But the transatlantic swap soon leads to more romantic entanglements for the two women.

programme.title: Christmas with the Kranks
programme.desc: Seasonal comedy starring Tim Allen and Jamie Lee Curtis. After their daughter goes to Peru to serve with the Peace Corps, Luther and Nora Krank face their first Christmas alone. Miserable at the prospect, they decide to completely forget yuletide and go on a Caribbean cruise. But their change of plan doesn't go smoothly.

programme.title: Surviving Christmas
programme.desc: Comedy starring Ben Affleck, James Gandolfini and Christina Applegate. Wealthy advertising executive Drew Latham faces Christmas alone after quarrelling with his girlfriend, so he decides to revisit his old childhood home, only to find it now occupied by the Valco family. Desperate for company, he pays the Valcos to let him spend the holiday season with them as their son. While dad Tom is happy to take the cash, the rest of the clan don't take too kindly to Drew's presence, especially daughter Alicia.

programme.title: White Christmas
programme.desc: Musical starring Bing Crosby and Danny Kaye. Old army buddies Phil Davis and Bob Wallace travel with the glamorous Haynes sisters to the Columbia Inn in Vermont. There, Phil and Bob are reunited with their old commanding officer, General Waverly, who is now struggling to keep the hotel going. The visitors decide there's only one answer - to put on a show.

programme.title: The Polar Express
programme.desc: Seasonal animated fantasy featuring Tom Hanks. On Christmas Eve, a young boy lies in bed pondering if Santa Claus really exists. Startled by a thunderous sound, he goes outside to discover a magical train destined for the North Pole. As he cautiously climbs on board, he begins an amazing journey that changes his view of the festive season for ever.

programme.title: Nativity!
programme.desc: Comedy starring Martin Freeman. Despite being traumatised by a bad review years earlier, primary school teacher Paul Maddens is tasked with directing the annual Nativity play. Taunted by a teacher from a rival school, Paul foolishly promises that an old flame, now a Hollywood producer, is coming to see his production.

programme.title: Nativity 2: Danger in the Manger!
programme.desc: Comedy starring David Tennant and Jessica Hynes. Jingle bells give way to alarm bells when a hapless new teacher agrees to take the pupils of St Bernadette's to rural Wales to compete in a clash of the Christmas choirs. And it just so happens that his twin brother is conducting a rival group.

programme.title: Nativity 3: Dude, Where's My Donkey?!
programme.desc: Comedy starring Martin Clunes, Catherine Tate and Marc Wootton. When new teacher Mr Shepherd loses both his memory and Archie the school donkey, it's up Mr Poppy and the kids of St Bernadette's to find the animal and reunite their amnesiac tutor with his girlfriend in New York.

programme.title: Elf
programme.desc: Seasonal comedy fantasy starring Will Ferrell and James Caan. Raised by Santa's helpers at the North Pole, human infant Buddy matures into a strapping adult and outgrows his cramped surroundings. His resultant determination to find his real father, Walter, sends Buddy on an exciting trip to New York.

Following the birth of their son, Mr Fox agrees to keep his word to his wife that his wild days are behind him. But when the family moves to a new home overlooking the farms of Boggis, Bunce and Bean, Mr Fox is tempted to resume his old poaching ways.

In a tranquil mountain town, domesticated grizzly bear Boog enjoys an idyllic life as the star of a wildlife show. But when he meets hyperactive deer Elliot, he gets into so much trouble that his keeper decides it's time to release him back into the wild. Problem is, hunting season is fast approaching and there's a tenacious hunter who's determined to bag both Boog and Elliot.

programme.title: Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Animated comedy spin-off from Madagascar, featuring the guest voices of John Malkovich and Benedict Cumberbatch. Resourceful penguins Skipper, Kowalski, Private and Rico team up with an undercover organisation to stop a malevolent mollusc from destroying the world.

programme.title: The Lego Ninjago Movie
programme.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voices of Jackie Chan, Dave Franco and Justin Theroux as the Lego figures. Teenager Lloyd is secretly part of a team of heroes who protect their city from the evil Lord Garmadon - who happens to be Lloyd's father.

programme.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy featuring the voices of Bette Midler and James Marsden. When one crazed feline goes to extreme lengths to take power, cats and canines are forced to do the unthinkable and join forces for the first time in history.

programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure. When the secret formula for the addictive Krabby Patty is stolen by pirate Burger Beard, Mr Krabs seconds SpongeBob to head into the live-action world and get it back. But will the dastardly pirate give it up without a fight?

programme.desc: Animated musical adventure featuring the voices of Justin Timberlake and Anna Kendrick. The happy land of trolls comes under threat from the Bergens, their miserable, giant neighbours who have developed a taste for trolls. When their kinfolk are kidnapped, bickering trolls Branch and Princess Poppy set out to free them before they're served up for dinner.

But they and their new musical rivals, The Chipettes, must put their pop prowess to use in order to save the school's music programme by winning a battle of the bands competition.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking
programme.desc: Comedy with John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. Mollie is an accountant who has an affair with a married client and becomes pregnant. As the embryo develops it is strangely able to speak from its mother's womb. Later, when she goes into premature labour, a kind-hearted taxi driver comes to her aid.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Too
programme.desc: Comedy sequel to the blockbuster Look Who's Talking, starring John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. Mikey is still trying to cope with the trials of potty training when he is presented with another bombshell: he is to get a sister. And, as if that wasn't enough, relations between his parents James and Mollie aren't going so well, either.

programme.title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
programme.desc: A stressed businessman just wants to make it home to spend Thanksgiving with his family. However, when his flight is forced to land miles from its destination, he finds himself sharing a disaster-strewn journey across America with an amiable but slobbish salesman. Comedy road movie, starring Steve Martin, John Candy, Laila Robins, Kevin Bacon and Michael McKean

programme.title: Tootsie
programme.desc: A New York actor's difficult reputation has rendered him unemployable. When a TV soap advertises a new female role, he disguises himself as a woman for the audition - and wins the part. But the character proves so popular, he is forced to keep up the pretence indefinitely. Comedy, starring Dustin Hoffman, Jessica Lange and Bill Murray. Directed by Sydney Pollack, who makes a cameo appearance as Hoffman's agent

programme.title: Risky Business
programme.desc: Risqué teen comedy starring Tom Cruise and Rebecca De Mornay. Left to safeguard the family home while his parents are away, promising student Joel Goodson seizes the chance to have the time of his life. But when a friend's prank results in Joel being visited by troubled prostitute Lana, things get out of hand.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Epic Storytelling
programme.desc: This week's edition of the Cinema List is all about epic storytelling. From The Shawshank Redemption to Dunkirk, witness unforgettable tales of hope, courage and survival

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Satirical comedy of suburban paranoia starring Tom Hanks. Ray Peterson's peace of mind is being eroded by the seemingly sinister goings-on next door. Are the mysterious Klopeks really neighbours from hell, doing dastardly deeds at the dead of night? Or are they just quiet people minding their own business? The "good people" of Mayfield Place are determined to discover the hideous truth.

programme.title: Dad's Army
programme.desc: Comedy adapted from the popular TV sitcom, starring Arthur Lowe, John Le Mesurier and Clive Dunn. In 1940, with a German invasion threatened, the defence of Walmington-on-Sea is in the hands of Captain Mainwaring, the bank manager, and a motley collection of townspeople who make up the Local Defence Volunteers.

programme.title: Smokey and the Bandit
programme.desc: Comedy starring Burt Reynolds, Sally Field and Jackie Gleason. Bandit is a maverick driver who never refuses a challenge, and no cop - or "smokey" - is going to stop him. However, Sheriff Buford T Justice has other ideas, and the chase is on as the Bandit and his friends try to get a truckload of illicit beer from Texarkana, Texas, to Atlanta, Georgia.

programme.title: Blazing Saddles
programme.desc: Spoof western starring Cleavon Little and Gene Wilder. Sheriff Bart fights prejudice and corruption to save the little town of Rock Ridge from wicked speculator Hedley Lamarr, helped by the once legendary Waco Kid.

programme.title: The Witches of Eastwick
programme.desc: Three single women dabble in magic to conjure up the perfect lover, and unintentionally summon Satan himself, who seduces them one by one. They come to realise the danger the lecherous devil presents and decide to end their relationships, but the infernal rogue does not take kindly to rejection. Fantasy comedy based on John Updike's novel, with Jack Nicholson, Cher, Michelle Pfeiffer and Susan Sarandon

programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Steve Guttenberg. Given 30 days to halt the crime wave in his precinct, Captain Pete Lassard recruits six rookie cops from his brother's police academy. But the rookies' ineptitude and an ambitious lieutenant soon put Lassard's job in jeopardy.

programme.title: Police Academy 3: Back in Training
programme.desc: Comedy starring Steve Guttenberg. When cutbacks mean the closure of one of the state's two police academies, both institutions become locked in a desperate battle for survival.

programme.desc: Comedy starring Steve Martin and Kathleen Turner. Brain surgeon Dr Michael Hfuhruhurr uses his pioneering skills to save beautiful but deadly Dolores Benedict following an accident. The two are soon married, but not happily so, and on a trip to Vienna he falls in love with a disembodied brain.

programme.title: So I Married an Axe Murderer
programme.desc: A poet has a history of ruining relationships owing to his paranoia, but when he meets the woman of his dreams, he resolves to make this romance last. However, as their wedding day approaches, he becomes convinced she is a notorious serial killer the police are hunting for. Comedy, starring Mike Myers and Nancy Travis

Bickering agents Luke Hobbs and Deckard Shaw are paired up to track down a deadly supervirus that has been stolen by terrorist Brixton Lore. But Lore is no ordinary villain - he has been implanted with cybernetic technology that gives him superhuman strength.
