programme.desc: Welcome to a Cinema List 65 million years in the making, going through the best moments from the Jurassic franchise - from the 1993 original to Jurassic World: Dominion

programme.title: Kong: Skull Island
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Tom Hiddleston, Brie Larson and Samuel L Jackson. A group of scientists and mercenaries are sent to a newly discovered Pacific island to investigate its unusual fauna. When their convoy is destroyed, the team faces a battle for survival against Skull Island's monstrous inhabitants - among them a certain giant ape.

programme.title: The Patriot
programme.desc: Period war drama starring Mel Gibson as a widower and committed pacifist, who is reluctantly dragged into the American War of Independence after one of his sons falls victim to a sadistic British colonel.

Historical action adventure starring Gerard Butler, Lena Headey and David Wenham. When the fiercely ambitious King Xerxes of Persia plans to invade Greece, King Leonidas mobilises his personal bodyguard of 300 Spartan warriors to defend the pass at Thermopylae.

programme.title: 300: Rise of an Empire
programme.desc: Ruler of the Persian empire and self-proclaimed god Xerxes continues his campaign to crush the emerging Greek nation, forcing a general from the democratic city state of Athens to lead his navy into battle against Xerxes' vast armada. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Sullivan Stapleton, Eva Green and Lena Headey

programme.title: Fast & Furious Presents: Hobbs & Shaw
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Dwayne Johnson, Jason Statham and Idris Elba. Bickering agents Luke Hobbs and Deckard Shaw are paired up to track down a deadly supervirus that has been stolen by terrorist Brixton Lore. But Lore is no ordinary villain - he has been implanted with cybernetic technology that gives him superhuman strength.

programme.title: The Expendables
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Sylvester Stallone, Jason Statham and Jet Li. A highly skilled group of mercenaries are commissioned by a shady operative to assassinate the murderous dictator of a South American island. But they should know that an operation like this is never straightforward.

programme.title: The Expendables 2
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Sylvester Stallone, Jason Statham and Bruce Willis. The crack team of mercenaries take on what looks like the easy job of retrieving an item from a crashed plane in Albania. But when one of the group is murdered by an international arms dealer, it turns into a mission of revenge.

programme.title: The Expendables 3
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Sylvester Stallone. Mercenary Barney Ross decides to retire his ageing band of cohorts and replace them with younger models for a mission to capture a ruthless adversary from his past. But when things get sticky, help comes from an unlikely direction.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: Period horror adventure starring Brendan Fraser and Jet Li. Intrepid explorers Rick and Evelyn O'Connell come out of retirement to join their archaeologist son Alex in a race to prevent the resurrected Dragon Emperor and his terracotta army from taking over the world.

programme.title: Zoolander 2
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Ben Stiller, Owen Wilson and Penélope Cruz. Once-legendary catwalk icon Derek Zoolander is lured back into the fashion business by a beautiful agent investigating a spate of celebrity deaths.

programme.title: Seven Psychopaths
programme.desc: Black comedy drama starring Colin Farrell, Christopher Walken, Sam Rockwell and Woody Harrelson. Struggling screenwriter Marty finds inspiration for his next script in the dog-napping operation run by his nefarious best friend Billy and his partner Hans. But the target of their next sting is going to put everyone's lives in danger.

programme.title: Mamma Mia!
programme.desc: Musical romantic comedy featuring the music of Abba, and starring Meryl Streep, Colin Firth and Pierce Brosnan. On an idyllic Greek island, young Sophie Sheridan prepares to marry the man of her dreams. But a problem looks set to blight the big day as the bride doesn't know who her father is. So Sophie sends out invitations to three men who might fit the bill, hoping to solve the riddle once her guests arrive.

programme.title: Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again
programme.desc: Musical romantic comedy sequel starring Lily James, Amanda Seyfried and Jeremy Irvine and featuring the songs of Abba. A now happily married Sophie prepares to reopen her late mother Donna's hotel. Meanwhile flashbacks show a young Donna discovering Greece and falling in love - several times.

programme.title: Talladega Nights: The Ballad of Ricky Bobby
programme.desc: Comedy starring Will Ferrell, John C Reilly and Sacha Baron Cohen. Nascar racing champion Ricky Bobby has all the trappings of a successful career: a glamorous wife, a luxury home and a fanatical fan base. But when French driver Jean Girard threatens Ricky's dominance, he seems ill-equipped to meet the challenge.

programme.title: Yesterday
programme.desc: Fantasy comedy starring Himesh Patel and Lily James. Cycling home after a gig, aspiring musician Jack is hit by a bus during a strange power cut. He wakes up to find himself in a world where nobody has heard of the Beatles, so takes advantage of this by passing their songs off as his own. Success soon comes his way, but it threatens to come between him and his manager and best friend, Ellie.

programme.title: Paul
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. On their much anticipated road trip to America's notorious Area 51, two sci-fi geeks find themselves in the company of a real-life extraterrestrial who needs their help.

programme.title: Seven Psychopaths
programme.desc: Black comedy drama starring Colin Farrell, Christopher Walken, Sam Rockwell and Woody Harrelson. Struggling screenwriter Marty finds inspiration for his next script in the dog-napping operation run by his nefarious best friend Billy and his partner Hans. But the target of their next sting is going to put everyone's lives in danger.

programme.title: Mr Deeds
programme.desc: Remake of Frank Capra's comedy Mr Deeds Goes to Town, starring Adam Sandler and Winona Ryder. Longfellow Deeds lives an uncomplicated life as a pizza-shop owner and aspiring greetings-card writer in a tiny town. But his world is thrown into disarray when he inherits a fortune from an unknown uncle.

programme.title: Marmaduke
programme.desc: Canine comedy featuring the voice of Owen Wilson. When the family of irrepressible Great Dane Marmaduke moves to a new home in California, it all proves to be something of a culture shock for the hapless hound, who continues to wreak havoc wherever he goes.

programme.title: Zoolander
programme.desc: Satirical comedy starring Ben Stiller as Derek Zoolander, the vain, self-absorbed king of the male-modelling world. But Zoolander's fame and fortune are threatened when he's brainwashed into assassinating an eminent statesman whose proposed new child-labour laws would spell disaster for the fashion industry.

programme.title: Zoolander 2
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Ben Stiller, Owen Wilson and Penélope Cruz. Once-legendary catwalk icon Derek Zoolander is lured back into the fashion business by a beautiful agent investigating a spate of celebrity deaths.

programme.title: Just Friends
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Ryan Reynolds, Amy Smart and Anna Faris. Chris was once an overweight loser, but is now slim, successful and a compulsive womaniser. Returning to his home town, he becomes determined to win the heart of the girl who was his best friend in high school.

programme.title: Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again
programme.desc: Musical romantic comedy sequel starring Lily James, Amanda Seyfried and Jeremy Irvine and featuring the songs of Abba. A now happily married Sophie prepares to reopen her late mother Donna's hotel. Meanwhile flashbacks show a young Donna discovering Greece and falling in love - several times.

programme.title: Lifehack
programme.desc: Kyle and his friends spend their nights hacking for kicks, humiliating online scammers with elaborate digital pranks. But craving a bigger score, they set their sights on tech billionaire Don Heard, infiltrating his world through his daughter Lindsey's social media accounts. Thriller, starring Georgie Farmer and Yasmin Finney

programme.title: Dirty Harry
programme.desc: Crime thriller starring Clint Eastwood. San Francisco cop "Dirty" Harry Callahan is assigned the case of a sniper who has murdered a young girl and threatened further killings if his ransom demand is not met. Dismayed to find himself partnered with a raw recruit, Callahan is soon at odds with his bosses over whether to pay off the killer.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: Erotic thriller starring Michael Douglas and Sharon Stone. After a former rock star is brutally murdered with an ice pick, San Francisco detective Nick Curran interviews Catherine Tramell, the star's novelist girlfriend, whose last book contained an identical killing. Curran, who is trying to reform his excessive lifestyle with the help of a police psychologist, soon becomes dangerously involved with his key suspect.

programme.title: Hallow Road
programme.desc: Two parents are thrust into a desperate race against time after a late-night call from their daughter reveals she caused a devastating car accident. Director Babak Anvari's psychological thriller, starring Rosamund Pike and Matthew Rhys

programme.title: Murder by Numbers
programme.desc: Detective thriller starring Sandra Bullock and Ben Chaplin. An overprivileged teenager and his bookish companion think they have committed the perfect murder, but emotionally damaged cop Cassie Mayweather has a hunch that they are the culprits. Her problem is convincing sceptical colleagues that she's right.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Cold War action thriller starring Sean Connery, Alec Baldwin and Scott Glenn. The trial voyage of new Soviet submarine Red October does not go as expected. Equipped with an experimental new propulsion system that makes it virtually impossible to track and captained by the enigmatic Marko Ramius, the heavily armed vessel heads for America. Is Ramius about to launch an undetectable, pre-emptive nuclear strike?

programme.title: Mr & Mrs Smith
programme.desc: Romantic action comedy starring Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie. Dissatisfied married couple John and Jane Smith live an outwardly respectable existence in suburbia, but they are soon shocked to discover their similar secret - they are both sophisticated professional assassins and their next lethal assignment is to kill one another.

programme.title: The Girl on the Train
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on the bestselling novel, starring Emily Blunt and Rebecca Ferguson. Divorce is made all the more painful for Rachel Watson because her morning commute takes her past the home where her ex-husband lives with his new wife. Rachel becomes curious about an attractive couple living close by, and her interest develops into an obsession when the woman is declared missing. Although convinced she may know something about the disappearance, Rachel's strained emotional state and a history of alcohol abuse make her story hard to believe.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: Political thriller starring Harrison Ford and Willem Dafoe. When Jack Ryan is asked to investigate the murder of a friend of the US President, he finds himself up against not only a Colombian drugs cartel but also corrupt American government officials.

programme.title: Black Bag
programme.desc: When a spy is suspected of treason, her husband faces the ultimate test - loyalty to his marriage or his country. Director Steven Soderbergh's thriller, starring Michael Fassbender, Cate Blanchett and Rege-Jean Page

programme.title: The Equalizer
programme.desc: Crime thriller based on the hit US TV series, starring Denzel Washington. On the face of it, Robert McCall is just an ordinary guy who works at a DIY store and leads a quiet life. But when McCall befriends a young girl controlled by ruthless Russian gangsters, he's unable to stand idly by and resorts to using skills from his shady former career.

programme.title: The Equalizer 2
programme.desc: Crime thriller starring Denzel Washington and Pedro Pascal. Now living a peaceful life, former Marine and government agent Robert McCall offers his singular skills pro bono to those in need. However, when his friend is killed under suspicious circumstances, McCall investigates, and uses any means necessary to see justice served.

programme.title: Five Nights At Freddy's 2
programme.desc: One year after the supernatural nightmare at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, Mike and Vanessa are pulled back into a terrifying series of events. Horror sequel, starring Josh Hutcherson and Elizabeth Lail

programme.title: Flatliners
programme.desc: Five medical students embark on a daring experiment. By stopping their hearts for short periods, each triggers a near-death experience, giving them a first hand account of the afterlife. Sci-fi drama based on the 1990 thriller, starring Elliot Page, Diego Luna and Nina Dobrev

programme.title: Beast of War
programme.desc: A group of soldiers get stranded on a raft in the middle of the ocean after their ship is sunk, and must battle a great white shark. Writer/director Kiah Roache-Turner's horror thriller, starring Mark Coles Smith and Joel Nankervis

programme.title: The Last Starfighter
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Lance Guest and Dan O'Herlihy. Alex is a bored teenager who lives with his mother and young brother in a trailer park. The chance for adventure comes when Starfighter, the video game he plays, becomes reality.

programme.title: Sick
programme.desc: Due to the pandemic, Parker and her best friend decide to quarantine at the family lake house alone - or so they think. Horror, starring Gideon Adlon, Bethlehem Million and Dylan Spradberry

programme.title: Critters
programme.desc: Horror comedy starring Dee Wallace Stone and M Emmet Walsh. After escaping from their space prison, eight small carnivorous aliens called Krites land on Earth pursued by two merciless bounty hunters. A sleepy Kansas community is soon the scene for violent murder, as the Krites discover a new and very tasty addition to their menu.

programme.title: Five Nights At Freddy's 2
programme.desc: One year after the supernatural nightmare at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, Mike and Vanessa are pulled back into a terrifying series of events. Horror sequel, starring Josh Hutcherson and Elizabeth Lail

programme.title: Men in Black 3
programme.desc: Science-fiction comedy starring Will Smith and Josh Brolin. The fight against aliens is taken to a new dimension when Agent J is forced to travel back to 1969 in an effort to prevent his partner's murder by ruthless fugitive Boris the Animal.

programme.title: Men in Black: International
programme.desc: Sci-fi action comedy starring Tessa Thompson and Chris Hemsworth. Agent M, an eager rookie in the secret MIB organiation, is sent to the London office where she's partnered with laid-back Agent H. When their first assignment together ends in disaster, M begins to suspect a mole must have infiltrated the agency. But who could it be - and is her partner to be trusted?

programme.title: The Chronicles of Riddick
programme.desc: Sci-fi thriller, the sequel to Pitch Black, starring Vin Diesel. Antihero convict Riddick finds himself on the run from intergalactic bounty hunters, but when he seeks refuge on a strange planet he discovers that the place has been overrun by the all-powerful Necromongers, storm-troopers bent on universal annihilation.

programme.title: Assassin's Creed
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Michael Fassbender and Marion Cotillard. An Assassin descendant must explore his genetic memories to end the ancient war between his clan and the Templars. Travelling back in time to 15th-century Spain, he gathers the skills and powers he needs to defeat his enemies in the present day.

programme.title: The Lost Boys
programme.desc: Horror comedy starring Jason Patric and Kiefer Sutherland. A small town in northern California hides the darkest of secrets. It's a place where a Vampires Everywhere comic could save your life and where, if you are very unlucky, you'll never grow old, you'll never die and you'll always have fresh blood to drink.

programme.title: Zombieland: Double Tap
programme.desc: Horror comedy starring Woody Harrelson, Jesse Eisenberg, Emma Stone and Abigail Breslin. Five years after they met, makeshift family Tallahassee, Columbus, Wichita and Little Rock are living a comfortable apocalyptic life in the abandoned White House. When friction arises within the group, Wichita and Little Rock fly the coop, prompting Tallahassee and Columbus to head back into the zombie wasteland to look for them.

programme.title: Nosferatu
programme.desc: In 1838 Germany, Thomas Hutter is sent to the Carpathian mountains to secure the signature of enigmatic nobleman Count Orlok on a property sale in the German city of Wisborg. Thomas leaves his bride Ellen in the care of friend Friedrich Harding and his wife Anna. The young man barely survives the exhausting trip to Europe and stumbles home to find Ellen driven to delirium by a telepathic bond to the Count. Director Robert Eggers' version of the Dracula-inspired horror, starring Bill Skarsgard, Lily-Rose Depp, Nicholas Hoult and Aaron Taylor-Johnson

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc: Horror sequel starring Jamie Lee Curtis, James Jude Courtney and Nick Castle. Psychopath Michael Myers has been incarcerated for 40 years, following his killing spree in small-town Haddonfield. Living in fear of Myers's possible return, survivor Laurie Strode has turned her home into a fortress and prepared her sceptical family for the worst. When Myers escapes, the stage is set for a showdown.

programme.title: The Sentinel
programme.desc: Conspiracy thriller starring Michael Douglas and Kiefer Sutherland. US Secret Service agent Pete Garrison has dedicated his life to serving his country's leaders, until a failed lie detector test makes him the number one suspect in a plot to assassinate the current occupier of the White House. Garrison is forced on the run in a race against time to clear his name, pursued by top operative David Breckinridge, who has his own score to settle.

programme.title: Maximum Conviction
programme.desc: Two special forces agents are given the task of transporting a pair of female convicts to prison, only to come under attack by a mercenary force sent to kill them. When they discover the true identity of the women in their charge, they realise the situation is even more dangerous than it seems. Action adventure, starring Steven Seagal and Steve Austin

programme.title: MacShayne: Final Roll of the Dice
programme.desc: Kenny Rogers plays Las Vegas casino troubleshooter John MacShayne, who gets mixed up in the murder of a famous entertainer. Crime drama, with Maria Conchita Alonso, Michael McKean and Daniel Hugh Kelly

programme.title: The Lost World
programme.desc: A mysterious drumbeat echoes through the forest as a beautiful stranger begins to follow Roxton. The woman, Danielle, and her village were victims of a Trog attack, and she seeks refuge at the treehouse. Though she has charmed the male explorers, Marguerite and Victoria remain suspicious of her.

programme.desc: Buying goods from the comfort of home

programme.title: Ape vs Monster
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Eric Roberts and Arianna Scott. An ape lost in space crash-lands back on Earth and finds itself expanding to giant proportions.

But nothing in the crew's service has prepared them for what they are about to face.

programme.title: Martian Land
programme.desc: In the distant future, humans are living on Mars in cities that resemble those once found on Earth, and are protected from the inhospitable Martian atmosphere by dome-like force-fields. When a massive sandstorm breaks through the dome and destroys Mars New York, those in Mars Los Angeles must figure out how to stop the storm before it wipes them out next. Sci-fi drama, starring Alan Pietruszewski, Jennifer Dorogi and Lane Townsend

programme.desc: While gathering herbs, Challenger inadvertently falls into a trap set by young hunters. The child-hunters take Challenger to their village, a hidden camp populated by orphans. Veronica and Marguerite track Challenger and his captors to their village, where they discover that its orphans are protected by a carnivorous plant that emits poisonous gases.

programme.desc: David makes an intriguing discovery in an abandoned railroad car

programme.title: xXx
programme.desc: Spy action thriller starring Vin Diesel as extreme-sports fanatic Xander Cage, who is coerced by the US government into infiltrating a Prague-based terrorist organisation when he falls foul of the law.

programme.title: Fugitives
programme.desc: A couple head to the Bahamas, hoping to revive their flagging marriage, but are soon fighting for their lives after being hunted by modern day pirates. Thriller, starring Dominic Purcell, Tricia Helfer and Luke Mably

programme.title: Hamlet
programme.desc: A grieving son returns to England to mourn his father, the CEO of Elsinore Property. The shell-shocked Hamlet learns plans are already afoot for his uncle Claudius to marry his mother Gertrude just days after losing her husband. Contemporary drama based on the Shakespeare classic, starring Riz Ahmed, Morfydd Clark, Joe Alwyn, Timothy Spall and Art Malik

programme.title: The Brutalist
programme.desc: Epic period drama starring Adrien Brody, Felicity Jones and Guy Pearce. In 1947, Hungarian architect and Holocaust survivor László Tóth arrives in America. After a rocky start in this new land, he finds his luck changing when he meets a wealthy industrialist who wants László to build an ambitious community project. However, for the tormented László and his wife, Erzsébet, this commission proves both blessing and curse.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Nov 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Asa Butterfield, Jack Scanlon and David Thewlis. After his Nazi officer father is given a promotion, young Bruno and his family are moved from Berlin to a remote house in the countryside. With nothing to do and no friends of his own age, Bruno becomes curious about a nearby building known as "the farm" and its oddly clothed inhabitants.

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: Oscar-winning western starring John Wayne as one-eyed US marshal "Rooster" Cogburn. When a young girl discovers that her father has been robbed and murdered, she persuades the hard-drinking Cogburn to track down the killer.

programme.title: A Star Is Born
programme.desc: Musical romantic drama starring Lady Gaga and Bradley Cooper. Rock star Jackson Maine meets aspiring songwriter Ally, a waitress who moonlights as a bar singer. Mesmerised by Ally's talent, Jackson invites her to perform with him and she becomes a sensation. The two begin a romantic relationship, but their happiness is threatened as an increasingly washed-up Jackson grapples with substance abuse issues.

programme.title: 28 Days
programme.desc: Drama starring Sandra Bullock. When her drunken exploits at a family wedding result in a car accident, party animal Gwen Cummings is forced into rehab. Initially scornful of her treatment and fellow patients, Gwen gradually comes to realise that her life needs to change.

programme.title: Terms of Endearment
programme.desc: Oscar-winning melodrama starring Shirley MacLaine, Debra Winger and Jack Nicholson. Aurora Greenway is an attractive widow whose main problems in life are fending off an alarming number of suitors and keeping her headstrong daughter Emma in check. But as the years pass by, Aurora's attitude to life and love, and her relationship with her daughter, begin to change.

programme.title: A Big Bold Beautiful Journey
programme.desc: New York bachelor David is due to drive to his friend's wedding, but a wheel clamp on his vehicle derails those plans. He acquires a new drive from the mysterious Car Rental Company managed by two nameless agents, who are oddly familiar with his dating history. At the wedding, David meets fellow singleton Sarah and squanders an opportunity to dance with her. On the way home, the rental car's GPS asks him if he would like to embark on a big bold beautiful journey. When David agrees, the virtual assistant guides him to Sarah and they follow a winding route between physical doors that open into episodes from their respective pasts. Romantic drama, starring Colin Farrell and Margot Robbie

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: Musical drama based on the Broadway show, starring Jamie Foxx, Beyoncé Knowles, Eddie Murphy and Oscar winner Jennifer Hudson. Three singers from Detroit known as the Dreamettes are put on the road to success by ruthless manager Curtis Taylor Jr. But his ambition to make the Dreamettes global stars soon takes its toll on the girls.

programme.title: Catch Me If You Can
programme.desc: Comedy drama, based on the true story of conman Frank Abagnale Jr, starring Leonardo DiCaprio and Tom Hanks. Shattered by the news that his parents are divorcing, 16-year-old Frank runs away to New York. For six years he lives a life of fraud, cashing over $2 million in bad cheques while impersonating an airline pilot, a paediatrician and a lawyer, and always staying one step ahead of tenacious FBI agent Carl Hanratty.

programme.title: Song Sung Blue
programme.desc: Musical drama based on a true story, starring Hugh Jackman and Kate Hudson. In the late 1980s, struggling Milwaukee musician Mike Sardina and part-time performer Claire Stengl find success - and love - when they team up to form a Neil Diamond tribute act named Lightning and Thunder. However, after a tragic accident threatens their livelihood, the couple fight to hold on to their dream.

programme.title: Pig
programme.desc: A chef-turned-reclusive-truffle hunter who lives alone in the Oregonian wilderness must return to his past in Portland in search of his beloved foraging pig after she is kidnapped. First-time director Michael Sarnoski's drama, starring Nicolas Cage, Alex Wolff and Adam Arkin

programme.title: Limbo
programme.desc: Comedy drama starring Amir El-Masry. Syrian refugee Omar and his fellow asylum seekers mark time on a remote Scottish island as they wait for their applications to be processed.

programme.title: The Mouse That Roared
programme.desc: Comedy starring Peter Sellers and Jean Seberg. A tiny European country is facing bankruptcy because its chief export - a very fine wine - is being undercut by an American company. The Prime Minister decrees that they must declare war on the USA, surrender and enjoy the benefits from their conquerors.

programme.title: Jubal
programme.desc: Western drama starring Glenn Ford and Ernest Borgnine. Drifter Jubal Troop's arrival at Shep Horgan's cattle ranch causes tension when he attracts advances from Horgan's young wife.

programme.title: Those Magnificent Men in Their Flying Machines
programme.desc: Period comedy starring Sarah Miles, James Fox and Stuart Whitman. London, 1910: when a wealthy newspaper baron puts up a £10,000 prize for the fastest flight from London to Paris, he attracts eccentric competitors from all over the world, including a young navy flier who hopes to win both the race and the hand of the sponsor's daughter.

programme.title: The Longest Day
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring John Wayne, Robert Mitchum, Henry Fonda and Robert Ryan. Normandy, 6 June 1944: as the huge task of preparing for D-Day draws to a close, the Allied commanders await suitable weather conditions to set in motion history's greatest amphibious operation.

programme.title: Attack the Block
programme.desc: Sci-fi action comedy starring Nick Frost, Jodie Whittaker and John Boyega. On the mean streets of south London, five teenagers in the process of mugging a woman are disturbed by an alien invader. Soon their housing estate is overrun with beings from outer space and the hunters have become the hunted.

programme.title: Talk to Me
programme.desc: Horror starring Sophie Wilde. Seventeen-year-old Mia goes to a party where her friends bring out a macabre centrepiece - an embalmed hand that enables the user to speak to the dead. Soon after, Mia experiences visions of her dead mother, and as the visions become more and more disturbing, Mia fears she has let something in that means to do her harm.

programme.title: The Unit
programme.desc: Jonas and the team travel to Brazil to track down surface-to-air missiles. Kim becomes unpopular at the base when she insists her group be allowed to deal with serious issues, and Hector searches for a way to tell his girlfriend the truth about his work. Drama, starring Dennis Haysbert and Audrey Marie Anderson

programme.title: The New Avengers
programme.desc: Steed receives a letter from an anonymous source informing him that Purdey has been kidnapped and demanding Allied attack plans as ransom. Espionage adventures, starring Patrick Macnee, Joanna Lumley and Gareth Hunt

programme.title: The Persuaders!
programme.desc: Beautiful girls and the Persuaders go hand in hand. When the playboys offer to help a young girl stranded on a country road, the "damsel in distress" proves quite incapable of keeping her honour.

programme.desc: Sci-fi thriller starring Esai Morales and Ona Grauer. After a UFO is shot down, strange and dangerous weather phenomena begin to occur across Seattle. A Nasa scientist must then rally his family together if they are to save each other and the region.

programme.title: Hitler's Bodyguard
programme.desc: As Adolf Hitler brutally consolidated his dictatorship in Germany and wiped out all opposition, the most serious threat to his rule came from an unexpected source - one of his oldest comrades who led the massive paramilitary army, which had played a vital role in bringing him to power.

programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc:
Steve and his trusty crew embark on an epic journey to a remote corner of Norway to experience a very special wildlife spectacle. Each year in November millions of herring pass through this area and deadly predators aren't far behind. For the first time ever Steve will be attempting to get in the water with one of these ultimate underwater hunters, the killer whale or orca. But first He needs to find them. Heading out on the fjords, everyone's eyes are peeled for the iconic dorsal fin. Reaching the height of Steve, it is hard to miss, and they finally spot a group in the distance. With the whales on the move, it's time for Steve to attempt to get his first underwater view of these ultimate animals. But as they are as fast as an Olympic swimmer, keeping up with them is tricky. He finally captures his first underwater glimpse, and the sound of their clicks as they chat away to each other is just beautiful.
But Steve wants to do better, and he knows just what to try. The orca in Norway have learnt a very unique way of finding their food: they follow the fishing boats, since where there are fishing boats, there are guaranteed to be herring. To witness this, Steve and the team head out in the dead of night. It won't be easy, though, as so many factors have to come together to make it work: the weather, the animals and the timing of the fishermen's catch. The first attempt is a failure, but the team will not give up.
As well as the orca mission, Steve and the team get to see the magical northern lights like never before and have an encounter with a mighty humpback they will never forget.

Camouflage, stealth and serious weaponry are the order of the day as Steve comes face to face with a highly venomous scorpion fish and witnesses the formidable spear mantis impaling its supper with its retractable spear-like arms.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc:
Duggee thought his tie was a little bit plain, so he added some accessories and now it looks amazing. The Squirrels admire Duggee's new look and want to learn how to accessorise themselves.
The first step for the Squirrels is to find something they'd like to change. The Squirrels each bring a different item - wellies, a T-shirt, headband, helmet and... a potato. They grab sequins, patches, feathers and lights, and then showcase what they have all done.
Norrie has added sequins to her T-shirt and made it into a new wonderfully sparkly outfit. Betty has added loads of useful items to her headband, like a calculator and a pencil, to wear it on all occasions. Roly has painted glow-in-the-dark paint on his wellies, and now he can splash in the dark. Tag has painted his helmet and added horns so he looks super-turbo! Roly has turned his potato into a beautifully made-up face with pink and yellow hair.
The Squirrels want to accessorise everything. Soon enough, the whole of the Clubhouse and the town are new and improved, but the Squirrels are getting tired. There's a chance they may have got carried away, so they go to work toning it down a touch. Less is more!

On the bus, they are joined by none other than Guy Fawkes, who tells them all about the city's link to himself and Bonfire Night. programme.desc: Part two of two. In September 1972, one month after Idi Amin announces his plan to expel all Ugandan Asians from the country, 80,000 people are making plans to flee, in fear for their lives. In the UK, controversial politician Enoch Powell rallies those who say the Ugandan Asians have no right to come, and some councils try to steer new arrivals away from their cities. Amin refuses to negotiate, stepping up the pressure on those stuck in the country

programme.desc: Hapless Liam wants his greatest passion to take flight with a darts-inspired wedding. Will his arrows extravaganza hit the target, or prove a load of old bull?

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: New buyers make their debut at the oldest facility in Los Angeles, Brandi and Jarrod try to piece their way to a win, and Ivy attempts to hoard most of the units for himself

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: The buyers hit Dan's home town, the Vegas Ladies' locker really takes off, Kenny's purchase sets his wallet alight, and Brandi and Jarrod put their vacation funds on the line

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: President of Moe's Southwest Grill, Paul Damico, goes undercover to check the standards he values are still being met. The company is one of the world's fastest growing restaurant chains with 10,000 employees and Paul wants to look for opportunities to assist his staff in a similar way to how his family were helped by his father's bosses during his childhood

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Sara Bittorf goes undercover among the workforce of restaurant chain Boston Market, where she is chief brand officer. Disguising herself as an out-of-work waitress trying to win the chance to open up her own eatery by taking part in a bogus reality TV show, she tries to revive the company's image by learning more about its staff

programme.title: America's Funniest Home Videos
programme.desc: Alfonso Ribeiro presents light-hearted entertainment and family-friendly laughs, as viewers' home video clips capture funny, surprising and memorable moments. Donkeys donkey around, a teen thinks her face has been removed after dental surgery, and two little girls say a traumatic goodbye - to their tablet

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Kenny tiptoes down memory lane, Brandi and Jarrod get to work on a tool locker, while Darrell and his granddaughter dig up a creepy find

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: The buyers lose their minds in West Covina, California. Kenny hunts for cougars, but finds a portable pulpit instead. Ivy shows the ladies how to dress for success

programme.title: Below Deck Down Under
programme.desc: Harry's fate on Katina is determined as we learn the extent of his injury. Marina asks Wihan on a date, sparking tension between her and Tzarina.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: The chef heads to floundering soul food restaurant Blackberry's in Plainfield, New Jersey, but struggles to get his message across to indomitable owner Shelley. Her refusal to deal with the truth comes to a head when Gordon finds a dead mouse in the doorway, prompting him to step up his efforts to change her ways

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay is in New Jersey to help Rose Leone, who spent two years in a coma and came out of hospital to learn her son Michael had run her once-thriving Italian restaurant into the ground. With a menu of more than 126 dishes, the quality of the food is suffering, and even the chefs refuse to eat their own creations

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown
programme.desc: Jimmy Carr hosts the comedy panel show's version of the words-and-numbers quiz, as Jon Richardson and David O'Doherty take on guest captain Johnny Vegas and Jamie Laing. Holly Walsh joins Countdown's resident lexicographer Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner and Rachel Riley looks after the numbers and letters

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown
programme.desc: Jimmy Carr hosts the comedy words-and-numbers quiz, as Jon Richardson and Jayde Adams compete against Sean Lock and Joe Wilkinson. David Baddiel joins Countdown's resident lexicographer Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner and Rachel Riley looks after the numbers and letters

programme.title: Taskmaster
programme.desc: The quest to take ownership of presenter Greg Davies' golden head continues, under the beady eye of 'little' Alex Horne. Mawaan Rizwan attempts an upside-down farm-related illusion, Daisy May Cooper softens some pasta and Katherine Parkinson lays waste to a garden arch. With Johnny Vegas and Richard Herring

programme.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure sequel starring Woody Harrelson and Andy Serkis. In the third instalment of the rebooted franchise, ape leader Caesar embarks on a quest for revenge after the crazed Colonel McCullough kills Caesar's family in a bid to assassinate him.

programme.title: Pig
programme.desc: A chef-turned-reclusive-truffle hunter who lives alone in the Oregonian wilderness must return to his past in Portland in search of his beloved foraging pig after she is kidnapped. First-time director Michael Sarnoski's drama, starring Nicolas Cage, Alex Wolff and Adam Arkin

programme.title: Limbo
programme.desc: Comedy drama starring Amir El-Masry. Syrian refugee Omar and his fellow asylum seekers mark time on a remote Scottish island as they wait for their applications to be processed.

programme.title: The Mouse That Roared
programme.desc: Comedy starring Peter Sellers and Jean Seberg. A tiny European country is facing bankruptcy because its chief export - a very fine wine - is being undercut by an American company. The Prime Minister decrees that they must declare war on the USA, surrender and enjoy the benefits from their conquerors.

programme.title: Jubal
programme.desc: Western drama starring Glenn Ford and Ernest Borgnine. Drifter Jubal Troop's arrival at Shep Horgan's cattle ranch causes tension when he attracts advances from Horgan's young wife.

programme.title: Those Magnificent Men in Their Flying Machines
programme.desc: Period comedy starring Sarah Miles, James Fox and Stuart Whitman. London, 1910: when a wealthy newspaper baron puts up a £10,000 prize for the fastest flight from London to Paris, he attracts eccentric competitors from all over the world, including a young navy flier who hopes to win both the race and the hand of the sponsor's daughter.

programme.title: The Longest Day
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring John Wayne, Robert Mitchum, Henry Fonda and Robert Ryan. Normandy, 6 June 1944: as the huge task of preparing for D-Day draws to a close, the Allied commanders await suitable weather conditions to set in motion history's greatest amphibious operation.

programme.title: Attack the Block
programme.desc: Sci-fi action comedy starring Nick Frost, Jodie Whittaker and John Boyega. On the mean streets of south London, five teenagers in the process of mugging a woman are disturbed by an alien invader. Soon their housing estate is overrun with beings from outer space and the hunters have become the hunted.

programme.title: Talk to Me
programme.desc: Horror starring Sophie Wilde. Seventeen-year-old Mia goes to a party where her friends bring out a macabre centrepiece - an embalmed hand that enables the user to speak to the dead. Soon after, Mia experiences visions of her dead mother, and as the visions become more and more disturbing, Mia fears she has let something in that means to do her harm.

Downton Abbey
programme.desc: It's the early autumn of 1924 and Rose's father-in-law Lord Sinderby has rented Brancaster Castle in Northumberland and invited the Crawleys to a grouse-shooting party. However, the Sinderbys' butler Stowell (guest star Alun Armstrong, New Tricks) has an axe to grind and a scandalous secret threatens to derail the holiday. programme.title: Hitler's Handmaidens

programme.desc: Leonard tells Penny he loves her, but fails to get the response he would have liked. Sheldon also finds himself competing against Star Trek: The Next Generation actor Wil Wheaton once again when the gang goes bowling - and tries to get his revenge

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Sheldon tries to hide the fact he had dinner with Penny after she broke up with Leonard, hoping to stay friends with her. However, keeping secrets does not prove to be his strong point, and it isn't long before his deceit is exposed. Comedy, starring Jim Parsons, Kaley Cuoco and Johnny Galecki

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Sheldon invites a famous physicist to the flat after befriending her online, but is put out to find Leonard showing an interest in her. Meanwhile, Penny has to confront her ex-boyfriend when the visitor turns up in his bedroom. Guest starring Judy Greer (Glenn Martin, DDS)

programme.title: Mock the Week
programme.desc: Dara Ó Briain introduces topical chat and hilarious games with two teams of top stand-up comedians as they look back over the week's news.

programme.title: Wayne's World
programme.desc: Comedy starring Mike Myers and Dana Carvey. Teenager Wayne and his best friend Garth broadcast a popular, if little known, cable TV show from Wayne's basement, where they dispense their home-spun wisdom about life, music and girls. The show is taken up by an ambitious television executive, who believes he can sell it to a sponsor.

programme.title: Jolly LLB 3
programme.desc: Two advocates with wildly different legal tactics seek justice for a farmer's widow after her late husband lost his land to a major developer.

programme.title: Hungama

programme.title: Rab Ne Bana Di Jodi

programme.title: Welcome Back
programme.desc: A pair of former gangsters attempt to play matchmakers for their own gain in this action comedy. Majnu and Uday have made successful, legal lives for themselves after spending years as gangsters, but their lives are changed when their father informs them that they have a sister, whom they previously didn't know about. Clive heads north from Lazio's capital, Rome, to the dramatic valleys of Italy's badlands, out of which rises the fairy-tale citadel of Civita di Bagnoregio - Lazio's ghost town.

programme.title: Joanna Lumley's Silk Road Adventure
programme.desc: The actress begins her journey along the ancient trade route, travelling thousands of miles across eight countries. She begins in Venice, Italy, where she sees how the travels of Silk Road traders influenced the growth of the small island state. She then travels to Albania and walks the beginning of the Via Egnatia, before reaching Turkey, where she uncovers centuries of trading and travelling history

programme.title: Joanna Lumley's Silk Road Adventure
programme.desc: Joanna Lumley follows the Silk Road from the Black Sea to the Caspian Sea, travelling across the post-Soviet states of Georgia and Azerbaijan. From the seaside resort of Batumi, on Georgia's Black Sea, Joanna travels across the heart of the Caucasus region, passing through stunning mountain settlements, cities and vineyards, and finally the uber-modern city of Baku, the capital of oil-rich Azerbaijan. On the way she learns not only about the ancient Silk Road, but how these two very different countries are still finding their identities

programme.title: Joanna Lumley's Silk Road Adventure
programme.desc: As her Silk Road journey continues, Joanna travels to the Islamic Republic of Iran, where she meets many people eager to share the culture and innovations of the Persian civilisation, which spread far beyond modern day Iran. From ancient water gardens created to be paradise on Earth, through desert cities, endless bazaars and majestic mosques, Joanna discovers a country brimming with hospitality and warmth. Her Iranian adventure finishes in the Persian Empire's ancient ceremonial capital, Persepolis

From the seaside resort of Batumi, on Georgia's Black Sea, Joanna travels across the heart of the Caucasus region, passing through stunning mountain settlements, cities and vineyards, and finally the uber-modern city of Baku, the capital of oil-rich Azerbaijan. programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo continues his 1936 Bradshaw's-inspired railway tour of north Wales. He begins in the coastal city of Bangor, where he hears how, when war broke out in September 1939, 2,000 children from the cities of northern England were evacuated by train to north Wales. Heading inland alongside the River Conwy, Michael reaches Tal y Cafn, before investigating the worst dam disaster in Welsh history in Dolgarrog. Finally in Betws y Coed, he attempts to climb one of Snowdonia's lesser peaks

programme.title: Tropic of Cancer with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: The third leg of Simon's journey takes him from the banks of the Nile to the edge of the Indian Ocean in Oman. programme.desc: Melodrama starring Madhuri Dixit. A female police officer's love for a colleague becomes problematic when another man falls in love with her.

programme.title: Mass Jathara
programme.desc: After being transferred to a small town, an honest railway cop fights to bring down a smuggling network ruled by a powerful drug lord.

programme.title: Dream Girl
programme.desc: Karamveer gets a job at a call centre due to his ability to talk in a woman's voice. He garners a big fan following but soon gets in trouble with his overzealous clients. Drama starring Ayushmann Khurrana, Nushrratt Bharuccha and Annu Kapoor.

programme.title: Pure Bollywood
programme.desc: Some of the best soundtracks of Bollywood uncut

programme.title: Judaai
programme.desc: A greedy woman marries a man she assumes to be rich, only to find him poor and too honest to ever become rich. When a besotted admirer offers to buy her husband for a large sum of money, she acdepts the deal - but does not realise the trouble her actions will bring her. Romantic drama, with Anil Kapoor, Sridevi and Urmila Matondkar

programme.title: Saajan Chale Sasural
programme.desc: A village-based singer attempts to find love and fame in the big city.

programme.title: Mr & Mrs Mahi
programme.desc: When a washed-up cricketer discovers his newlywed wife's talent on the pitch, he begins to coach her. But his resentment grows as she starts to shine.

programme.title: Coolie No. 1
programme.desc: Spurned by a rich man, matchmaker Shaadiram plans to teach him a lesson. Hilarious consequences arise when he gets Raju, a coolie, to pose as a millionaire and marry the man's daughter

programme.title: Coolie No. 1
programme.desc: Spurned by a rich man, matchmaker Shaadiram plans to teach him a lesson. Hilarious consequences arise when he gets Raju, a coolie, to pose as a millionaire and marry the man's daughter

programme.title: Dhadkan
programme.desc: Anjali and Dev are in love with each other and plan to marry, but her family gets her married to Ram. Years later, Dev shows up to reunite with Anjali, however, she has fallen in love with Ram

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Bioacoustics technology and AI have allowed scientists to not only decode complex animal sound data, but also begin communicating with animals. Hannah meets a 'talking dog' in California and deciphers elephant rumbles in Nairobi. She also looks into the question of whether the emerging ability to communicate with animals is one that should be exploited

programme.title: Blue Lights
programme.desc: Life is in the balance after the explosion at Katie's house, while Gerry's evidence on state collusion is released. The section race to put an end to Morgan's empire. Belfast police drama, starring Siân Brooke, Andi Osho, Cathy Tyson and Tabitha Smyth

programme.title: This City Is Ours
programme.desc: Cheryl returns to Liverpool with devastating news for Michael. With no way out, Michael is forced to make an impossible decision to protect the one he loves. Meanwhile, tensions rise among the Phelans as they hunt Banksey, unaware a new enemy is moving in the shadows

programme.title: The Bidding Room
programme.desc: Toy seller Martin drives a hard bargain with the bidders with his Dinky and Corgi car collection, Debbie hopes her musical curiosity will strike a chord and dealer Jo is bewitched by a painting with a mysterious history. Presented by Nigel Havers, with auctioneer Simon Bower on hand to value the items

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Maisie Adam, Ade Edmondson, Rickie Haywood-Williams and Sammi Kinghorn take part in the penultimate round of challenges. Michael Sheen asks the questions

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Paul and Bob return to Norfolk, and remember their travels with Ted at the first location in which he joined them. They try for bream at the lakes, testing Bob's dislike of the fish. During their birthday week, Bob surprises Paul with a 70s-themed party on the roof of the Blickling Estate, once owned by the Boleyn family

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: The presenter explores the promises and threats of artificial intelligence, considering the ways in which superintelligence machines can help humanity as well as the ways in which they can be a hindrance

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Political Thinking with Nick Robinson
programme.desc: The journalist in conversation with people who influence our political thinking about what has shaped theirs

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: Kate Robbins presents an appeal on behalf of PMRGCAuk, a charity providing support, information and advocacy for people affected by polymyalgia rheumatica and giant cell arteritis

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc:
Game show in which 30 players compete across the series, scoring points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.
In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

programme.title: The Answer Run
programme.desc: Jason Manford hosts the fast-paced quiz show where three couples face a series of 50/50 questions which hurtle down the Answer Run towards them

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: Sean Fletcher explores the food market in Hay-on-Wye, getting tips on home growing and finding out the secret to making fudge. Chef Julie Lin discovers bargains in world food stores and supermarket aisles, and food journalist Leyla Kazim lifts the lid on smoothies, while Ryan Hand finds out how to get wood-fired pizza perfection in an oven

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo's Scottish railway journey reaches Aberdeen. From the granite city, Michael heads out to Forvie National Nature Reserve, which is 1,000 hectares of protected coastal habitat dominated by grassy dunes

programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: Documentary following the daily lives of a bottlenose dolphin as it struggles to keep its newborn calf alive in the treacherous waters of Shark Bay, Western Australia. With the help of other females, the creature tries to teach the vulnerable baby the necessary tricks for survival in shark-infested waters

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team set up shop in Edinburgh to examine more objects brought in by the public for valuing. Items offered up for consideration include an early Mickey Mouse mascot, a rare Art Deco figurine and documents that were once the property of Edward VIII and Wallis Simpson's bodyguard. Originally shown in 2005

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: In Blackburn, Anita Manning values a gold charm bracelet and Philip Serrell takes a shine to an unusual globe. Paul Martin finds out about the life of singer Kathleen Ferrier

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Maisie Adam, Ade Edmondson, Rickie Haywood-Williams and Sammi Kinghorn take part in the final round of challenges on Double Points Friday. Michael Sheen asks the questions

programme.title: Strictly: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor is on hand with more exclusives ahead of the weekend's extravaganza. Plus, the all-star panel discuss the couples' next dances

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Analysis of the day's events with Matt Chorley

programme.title: Naturewatch
programme.desc: Chris Packham is joined by Kyle Thomas and Megan McCubbin for an exploration of Britain's wildlife, tackling the fascinating, the unexpected and the downright bizarre. Throughout the run, the team investigates some of nature's biggest mysteries, including where the acorns have all gone, why a group of crows is known as a murder and how small is Britain's smallest bird

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty Don presents his last programme from Longmeadow after 16 years, celebrating gardening's pleasures and making a final bulb lasagne. Autumn brings sowing, planting and apple gathering, while Carol Klein explores plant shoots, and Joe Swift visits Ann-Marie Powell's garden. Cameras also focus on a North Yorkshire tree grower, and a couple nurturing a garden

programme.title: Who Do You Think You Are?
programme.desc: Gardener and TV presenter Monty Don researches his ancestry, beginning by investigating his great-great-grandfather, a vicar who had a parish in Nottingham in the 1840s. He then learns about the Keiller marmalade dynasty on his father's side, and travels to Scotland to explore his great-grandfather's involvement in the business

programme.title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
programme.desc: A stressed businessman just wants to make it home to spend Thanksgiving with his family. However, when his flight is forced to land miles from its destination, he finds himself sharing a disaster-strewn journey across America with an amiable but slobbish salesman. Comedy road movie, starring Steve Martin, John Candy, Laila Robins, Kevin Bacon and Michael McKean

programme.title: Their Finest
programme.desc: Wartime comedy drama based on Lissa Evans's novel Their Finest Hour and a Half, starring Gemma Arterton, Bill Nighy and Sam Claflin. Catrin Cole travels from Wales into the thick of the London Blitz to work as a typist on propaganda films made by the Ministry of Information. And with the productions desperately needing a female perspective, Catrin seems the perfect person for the job.

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: The armchair critics share their opinions on what they have been watching during the week, with cameras capturing their instant reactions and the lively discussions that are prompted by the week's biggest and best shows

programme.title: Ramsay's Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay visits Angler's Lodge in Island Park, Idaho. Owner Dave Eby built the lodge with his own hands, but a family tragedy has caused him and wife Dede to shy away from the hotel and the community. Gordon is desperate to help mend this broken family - but is it too late to save their business?

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off: Second Helpings
programme.desc: Jon Richardson and Judi Love host the companion programme, in which they and their guests look back at the highlights of the earlier show, which saw the contestants baking gluten-free, dairy-free and vegan dishes. They celebrate the standout moments and serve up their take on the episode's biggest talking points and best bakes

programme.title: Pierre
programme.desc: After Pierre's sudden collapse, he's discharged from hospital under strict instructions to avoid stress. But when he receives an anonymous tip-off, he can't resist the chance to discover what really happened to Michael

programme.title: Swan Song
programme.desc: Drama starring Udo Kier. Ex-hairdresser Pat Pitsenbarger is lured out of retirement when a former client dies, leaving a request in her will that he do her hair and make-up for her funeral. A road trip ensues, during which the penniless Pat has to beg, borrow and steal to get the necessary cosmetic resources.

programme.title: A Place in the Sun
programme.desc: Joe and Emma from Kent have been married for 21 years. After years of holidaying in Spain, they've decided to sell up in the UK and make a permanent move along with their daughter Gracie to Spain's Mar Menor. programme.desc: Engineering enthusiast Guy Martin celebrates the workers of the Industrial Revolution by recreating some of the 19th century's most impressive technical achievements. Along the way he focuses on the unsung heroes of the time - the men, women and children who worked 14 hours a day for little pay to create extraordinary marvels that changed the country for ever. He begins by overhauling a steam locomotive currently in use on the Severn Valley Railway, repairing its boiler, safety valves and one of its two-ton wheels. programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
The team restores an elegant wooden desk connected to one of the 20th century's most important political movements. Susie and her niece Sophia have brought it to be restored. The desk belonged to Susie's grandmother, Una, a leading figure in the suffragette movement, along with her husband, Victor, who was equally passionate about the fight for women's rights. The desk is the place where Una wrote letters to her fellow campaigners, read her correspondence and wrote her diaries. Lucia Scalisi and Will Kirk join forces to bring this historic item into the 21st century while retaining its history.
On a campaign of her own, Kirsten Ramsay is tasked with reviving a shop mannequin that was badly bombed in the Blitz. The mannequin, named Bert, has been a family mascot for Rene for nearly a century. It took pride of place in the window of Rene's father's tailor shop in the East End of London in the 1920s, but when the shop was destroyed in the war, Bert suffered the consequences. Despite his dents and dings, Rene's daughter Shelley fell in love with Bert as a teenager when he was being brought down from the loft. Rene's vivid memories of Bert in the shop window in top hat and tails mean Kirsten enlists the skills of hatter Jayesh Vaghela to get Bert back on his smartly dressed feet once again.
The final visitors to the barn are Dave and his son Lewis from Glasgow, who are hoping Brenton West can get their sporting memento looking champion again. The trophy belonged to Dave's father, John, who won it while swimming a couple of miles in the cold waters of the Clyde in 1953 at the age of just 19. In later years, John became a frogman in the police, so his youthful swimming success served him well. It's a labour of love for Brenton, who brings the shine back into this symbol of John's fortitude and strength.

But his former employers are also on the trail with instructions to make sure that the meeting never happens.

Agent Aaron Cross manages to escape the onslaught, but must contact the scientist behind Operation Outcome to maintain his enhanced functions and foil his handlers.

Action thriller sequel directed by JJ Abrams, starring Tom Cruise, Philip Seymour Hoffman, Michelle Monaghan, Ving Rhames and Simon Pegg

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Ghost Protocol
programme.desc: Action spy thriller starring Tom Cruise. The elite Impossible Missions Force is officially disbanded after being blamed for a botched operation, forcing agent Ethan Hunt and his crack team to go off grid to prevent a terrorist from causing a nuclear disaster.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Rogue Nation
programme.desc: Spy adventure starring Tom Cruise. After the CIA chief persuades a Senate committee to disband the Impossible Missions Force, Ethan Hunt and his team are forced to act covertly. Their mission is to thwart a shadowy organisation known as the Syndicate, a network of rogue operatives plotting a series of global terror attacks.

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his billionaire industrialist boss, Cole Reed is framed for the crime and forced to go on the run as he uncovers an international conspiracy. Thriller, starring Jason Statham, Chaneil Kular and Ramon Tikaram

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Fallout
programme.desc: Action spy thriller starring Tom Cruise, Rebecca Ferguson and Henry Cavill. Ethan Hunt is sent to Berlin to buy three stolen plutonium cores before a terrorist group can get a hold of them. But after a hostage crisis leads to the failure of the mission, Hunt is targeted by a CIA assassin who could derail the IMF for good.

programme.title: The Equalizer 2
programme.desc: Crime thriller starring Denzel Washington and Pedro Pascal. Now living a peaceful life, former Marine and government agent Robert McCall offers his singular skills pro bono to those in need. However, when his friend is killed under suspicious circumstances, McCall investigates, and uses any means necessary to see justice served.

programme.title: A Clockwork Orange
programme.desc: Stanley Kubrick's controversial futuristic vision, dramatised from the novella by Anthony Burgess and starring Malcolm McDowell. Imprisoned after the brutal murder of a woman, Alex, leader of a gang of sadistic thugs, agrees to undergo behaviour therapy designed to turn him against violence. However, when he is released back into the community, the results of the treatment prove to be costly for the reformed Alex.

programme.title: Hallow Road
programme.desc: Two parents are thrust into a desperate race against time after a late-night call from their daughter reveals she caused a devastating car accident. Director Babak Anvari's psychological thriller, starring Rosamund Pike and Matthew Rhys

programme.title: Dead Man's Wire
programme.desc: Tony Kiritsis is convinced mortgage broker ML Hall cheated him out of profits from a land development deal and he vows revenge. Tony walks into a branch of the Meridian Mortgage company for a meeting with ML, only to find his target is on holiday and the appointment will be with ML's son Richard instead. Regardless, Tony reveals a shotgun and holds Richard hostage for his father's supposed crimes. Director Gus Van Sant's thriller, starring Bill Skarsgård, Al Pacino and Dacre Montgomery

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: Political thriller starring Harrison Ford and Willem Dafoe. When Jack Ryan is asked to investigate the murder of a friend of the US President, he finds himself up against not only a Colombian drugs cartel but also corrupt American government officials.

programme.title: The Girl on the Train
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on the bestselling novel, starring Emily Blunt and Rebecca Ferguson. Divorce is made all the more painful for Rachel Watson because her morning commute takes her past the home where her ex-husband lives with his new wife. Rachel becomes curious about an attractive couple living close by, and her interest develops into an obsession when the woman is declared missing. Although convinced she may know something about the disappearance, Rachel's strained emotional state and a history of alcohol abuse make her story hard to believe.

programme.title: Black Bag
programme.desc: When a spy is suspected of treason, her husband faces the ultimate test - loyalty to his marriage or his country. Director Steven Soderbergh's thriller, starring Michael Fassbender, Cate Blanchett and Rege-Jean Page

programme.title: The Equalizer
programme.desc: Crime thriller based on the hit US TV series, starring Denzel Washington. On the face of it, Robert McCall is just an ordinary guy who works at a DIY store and leads a quiet life. But when McCall befriends a young girl controlled by ruthless Russian gangsters, he's unable to stand idly by and resorts to using skills from his shady former career.

programme.title: The Equalizer 2
programme.desc: Crime thriller starring Denzel Washington and Pedro Pascal. Now living a peaceful life, former Marine and government agent Robert McCall offers his singular skills pro bono to those in need. However, when his friend is killed under suspicious circumstances, McCall investigates, and uses any means necessary to see justice served.

programme.title: Jaws
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg's classic adventure thriller, starring Roy Scheider, Robert Shaw and Richard Dreyfuss. The Atlantic resort of Amity Island is preparing for its lucrative summer season when death strikes in the form of a Great White shark. Rather than turn away business, Mayor Vaughn orders police chief Brody to keep the beaches open.

programme.title: Jaws 2
programme.desc: Sequel to Steven Spielberg's blockbuster, starring Roy Scheider as police chief Martin Brody, who fears that a great white shark is once again threatening the holiday resort of Amity. But with the summer season under way, Brody has a tough job convincing Amity's business community of the danger.

programme.title: Jaws 3
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Dennis Quaid and Louis Gossett Jr. Sheriff Brody's sons are working at a new marine park, where a captive infant great white shark is being groomed as the centre's latest tourist attraction. However, no one has reckoned on the creature's vengeful mother.

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: Comedy crime drama starring Brad Pitt, Jason Statham and Benicio Del Toro. In Antwerp, jewel thief Franky Four Fingers steals a huge diamond, but before he can deliver it to his New York boss he is ambushed in London by a Russian mobster's henchmen. Elsewhere in the capital, crimelord Brick Top demands that Irish boxer Mickey One Punch take a dive in an unlicensed fight. When Brick Top joins the hunt for the missing gem, mayhem ensues.

programme.title: Dad's Army
programme.desc: Comedy adapted from the popular TV sitcom, starring Arthur Lowe, John Le Mesurier and Clive Dunn. In 1940, with a German invasion threatened, the defence of Walmington-on-Sea is in the hands of Captain Mainwaring, the bank manager, and a motley collection of townspeople who make up the Local Defence Volunteers.

programme.title: Blazing Saddles
programme.desc: Spoof western starring Cleavon Little and Gene Wilder. Sheriff Bart fights prejudice and corruption to save the little town of Rock Ridge from wicked speculator Hedley Lamarr, helped by the once legendary Waco Kid.

programme.title: Smokey and the Bandit
programme.desc: Comedy starring Burt Reynolds, Sally Field and Jackie Gleason. Bandit is a maverick driver who never refuses a challenge, and no cop - or "smokey" - is going to stop him. However, Sheriff Buford T Justice has other ideas, and the chase is on as the Bandit and his friends try to get a truckload of illicit beer from Texarkana, Texas, to Atlanta, Georgia.

programme.title: Gremlins 2: The New Batch
programme.desc: Comedy horror starring Zach Galligan and Phoebe Cates, and featuring Christopher Lee. Billy Peltzer and his fiancée Kate Beringer have moved to New York after surviving the first nightmarish wave of gremlins. Both now work at a hi-tech skyscraper where, unknown to them, their old friend Gizmo is under the influence of the evil Dr Catheter.

programme.title: The Big Heat
programme.desc: Film noir starring Glenn Ford, Gloria Grahame and Lee Marvin. When tough detective Dave Bannion is assigned to investigate a colleague's suicide, he is sceptical about the reasons given for his death. Forced to work under cover, he discovers the existence of a suicide note that implicates a brutal Mob boss.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Cold War action thriller starring Sean Connery, Alec Baldwin and Scott Glenn. The trial voyage of new Soviet submarine Red October does not go as expected. Equipped with an experimental new propulsion system that makes it virtually impossible to track and captained by the enigmatic Marko Ramius, the heavily armed vessel heads for America. Is Ramius about to launch an undetectable, pre-emptive nuclear strike?

programme.title: Dog Day Afternoon
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Al Pacino, John Cazale and Charles Durning. On a hot August day in 1972, Sonny Wortzik and two accomplices enter a Brooklyn bank and hold the staff at gunpoint. But the robbery goes wrong and when police surround the building, Sonny and his morose friend Sal become trapped inside with their hostages.

programme.title: Dirty Harry
programme.desc: Crime thriller starring Clint Eastwood. San Francisco cop "Dirty" Harry Callahan is assigned the case of a sniper who has murdered a young girl and threatened further killings if his ransom demand is not met. Dismayed to find himself partnered with a raw recruit, Callahan is soon at odds with his bosses over whether to pay off the killer.
